tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sde gzhung sprul sku rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis 'jam mgon legs pa rin po cher bka' 'dri zhus lan khag cig /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje bla mas brtse bas gdams pa rnams rang gi dran pa gso ba'i phyir du yi ger bkod pa la/ khyod la na tsha dang mi 'dod pa gang byung ba thams cad lam du khyer shes na dngos grub kyi mtshams sbyor yin pas sgrub pa'i slong gang byung yang bdag la 'di 'dra yong ma thong snyam pa'i yi chad mi bya bar lta ba'i ngang skyong ba dang / bde sdug gtong len sogs kyi sgo nas lam du khyer thub dgos/ sngon 'bri gung skyob pa la mdze nad byung tshe bdag gis sngon chad 'bad pa de tsam byas kyang ma phan dgongs nas thugs skyo/ da nges par 'chi bar 'dug pas dur khrod zhig tu 'gro dgongs nas byon tshe/ phag gru'i sku brnyan gyi mdun du yan lag bdun ma mdzad pas/ da lta nga bas lhag pa'i sdug bsngal chen po myong ba gzhan su yod dgongs tshe ngan song gsum na gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal che bar mkhyen/ de dag la bzod glags med pa'i snying rje 'khrungs/ bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom mdzad pas phyag dang zhabs kyi sor mo rnams nas khrag mang po 'thon pa'i nyams shar/ yang yang bsgom mdzad pas/ 'og sgo nas dug sbrul zhig 'thon nas nad ma lus pa lhag med du dengs pa red/ khyod kyis kyang de 'dra la sems la na tsha sogs mi 'dod pa thams cad lam du bsrel e thub ltos/ sems chung chung ma byed gsung / mgon po'i gsang khrid kyi bla ma he ru ka'i g.yas rdo rje 'phyar thabs dang / g.yon thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa yin/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni mar rtse rdo rje rtse lnga pa dbus ra cung zad ring ba phyed pas mtshan pa/ yu ba sgal tshigs sam rkang rus de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje la 'phan sogs btags pa/ de'i steng du bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ de'i steng thod skam sum brtsegs/

de'i steng rdo rje rtse lnga pa yongs rdzogs can zhig go /chos skyong phal che ba'i phyag mtshan kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni rtse gsum yu ba la rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa yin gsung / yum chen gyi me yi phyag rgya zhes pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya yin/ ber nag zangs gri can mgon po'i bka' nyan pa'i las kyi mgon po yin/ nag po gnod sbyin dang ngo bo mi gcig gsung / 'jol ber gser ma sum brtsegs gos chen nag po gser ris can gyi ber sum brtsegs la zer gsung / gser gyi ska bo che ska rags red/ sag ri'i lham 'ba' sog la zer/ deng ben gser ma'i phod ka zhes pa gar chas kyi ber la zer gsung / dbang lha spyan 'dren sogs lha snam gyi steng du pad zla sogs lha dam tshig pa'i gdan gang yin pa de bsgom dgos/ gri gug lha lnga lta bu'i yab rkyang gi rigs bdag la yum med/ rnam pa he ru ka'i cha byad can bsgom/ yum gyi dod kha ṭ+wāṃ yod/ bla ma gong ma la las/ longs sku'i cha byad can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can bshad pa'ang 'dug rigs bdag gi spyi bor phyag mtshan rdo rje sogs kye rdor gyis rgyas bkab nas mgon po lta bu la bsgoms kyang btub/ dam tshig gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa da lta'i 'di 'dra la zer/ bla ma'i thugs kar sngags phreng rim bzhin bsgom pa yin/ sngags phreng las 'od zer dus gcig la spro ba de sgrub pa'i skabs dang po g.yon nas mo rgyud spro bsdu byas na 'tshub med cing 'jam pa yin/ las mkhan myang 'das skabs gnod sbyin yab yum 'od du zhu cha gcig mgon po/ gnyis lha mo dang zangs gri can la thim par bsam gzhan la'ang des 'gre gsung / 'khrul 'khor gyi mgon po sgrub thabs bsad pa'i 'khrul 'khor la zer/ myur mgyogs pho nya la sngags thung gis gtor ma phul nas sngags tsam gyis dam gzhag byas kyang chog skyabs 'gro'i skabs dgra bo mdun du bsgom pas dam sel mi 'byung /

khro bcu'i gdan gyi mi ro lha rang rang gi g.yas phyogs su mgo lta ba yin/ rdzogs rim nang khrid thun mong ba zhes pa rtsa'i nang du lha bsgom pa yar lung pa'i yig cha lta bu la zer/ 'dir rtsa thig rlung gsum ka lhar bsgom/ de'ang gtso bo'i sku lus phyag mdzub nang tshun chad stong sangs 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ lha rnams kyi lus kyi nang du rtsa mi bsgom par steng 'og tu rtsa yod pa/ lha rnams rang rgyud par mi bsam par rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gsum dregs pa rgyud gsum gyi ngo bor shar ba la nges pa rnyed pa'i lta ba'i ngang nas bsgom dgos gsung / snying chu bsre ba chos skyong dang mna' 'jog pa lta bu'i don yin/ me dmigs zhes pa drag po sngags rgod la zer gsung / rtsa 'khor rnams kha dog dkar dmar sogs su bsgom dgos/ gsang gnas kyi rtsa ba steng dang rtse mo'i phyogs la 'og byas nas rtsa 'khor bsgom pa dang lha'i dbu lta phyogs de ltar gyis/ kye rdor lus dkyil yang de dang 'dra gsungs/ yungs kar gyis brab tshe yungs kar 'bru re re nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa mang por bsam nas gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsgom pa yin/ phyogs skyong gi lag nas tshe bsdu zhes pa/ rang gi bla tshe de dag gis 'phrog pa tshur bsdu ba red/ pha ma'i khams dkar dmar gyi cha bzhi lus kyi sha rus kyi rgyur song / gnyis mi shigs pa'i 'khor lo sogs zer ba red/ sems 'grel skor gsum rdo rje snying po'i brtag gnyis rgyud 'grel/ rigs ldan gyi dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel/ phyag na rdo rje'i bde mchog stod 'grel gsum la zer/ bla ma dam pas bdag dang yid gcugs la zhes pa/ spyir rang gi bla ma dang yid gcugs la thugs mnyes par bsam pa las de dag bsgom mi dgos gsung / gri gug gi yu ba la de wa pi tsu'i 'bru re res mtshon pa yin/ ngag chos kyi khrid yig las 'di gtso bor gsungs/

'od zer spro bsdu ma gsung ba sngags phreng bkod pa tsam la dmigs nas bzlas pa byed/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa byed ces pa rnams la bdag bskyed la bzlas dmigs gang byed pa mdun bskyed la de bzhin byed pa'am/ yang na lha snang tsam la dmigs nas bzlas pa byed chog/ ༈ //mkha' spyod lus dkyil skabs zla ba nyi gdan du bsgyur ba dang / yid bzlas tshe zla gdan la bsgyur ba yin/ sbyin sreg gi rdzas rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin 'bul ba las dmigs pa gzhan ci'ang mi dgos gsung / ༈ /chos 'byung gi nang du yum chen bsgom/ dbu gtsug dang gsang gnas su rtsa zug pa zhig bsgom dgos gsung / sgrub pa'i skabs sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas lha rnams la thim par bsam gsung / bhan dmar zhes pa thod pa dkar po khrag gis bkang ba/ yum chen gyi thugs ka nas 'od chad sku lus kyi nang nas yar byung nas dbu gtsug nas 'thon par bsam gsung / mgon po'i tshe sgrub skabs bsnyen pa la pu ṇe dz+nyā med gsung / stag zhon la las grub nas 'khu ldog mi 'byung ba'i phyir zan gyi liṅga bcas te dgug gzhug byas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dmar nyog ger bsam la gtang rag bya'o/ /rtsa so so'i nang brgyud gnas so sor slebs pa na de'i rtsa thig rlung gsum ro gcig tu 'gyur pa las lha bskyed pa dang / mgon po'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ dang mam̐ sogs 'chad lugs 'gres/ gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi gdan rkyang pa'i steng du sa bon bsgom pa yin/ gzhan la 'gres/ dam bzhag gi rdo rje de'ang lha so so'i thugs kar gnas song bsam pa las gdan mi dgos/ khrid yig las lha dgu bskyed nas bsdu bar bshad pa de khrid kyi skabs su yin lags/ mgon po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la skyabs gnas thams cad bstim kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs su bsgom la gsol ba btab la rang la bstim nas de'i ngang nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa sogs la 'jug pa 'di bla ma 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin gyis skabs skabs su mdzad pas dgag dgos yod na mi legs pa med/

sla chos dang srol ngan byed mi rung gsung / mgon po mdun bskyed ltar sgrub tshul zhu chen bkra shis dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i srog 'phrog pa dang / srog gi yang thig blang pa'i bzlas dmigs byed tshul gsungs pa de/ khrid yig las phyi sgrub la bzlas dmigs 'di gnyis lan mang po mi rung bar bshad pa snga ma de yin gsung / lha spyan 'dren pa'i 'od tshur bsdu ba grub na dgos/ mgon po'i nyal ba'i rnal 'byor drag po sngags rgod kyis byas nas/ ldang ba'i tshe 'od gsal de'i ngang las chu las nya 'phar ba ltar ldang gsungs/ bla ma 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin gyis bsrung bzlog bsad mnan thams cad thun gcig la tshang ba'i dbang du mdzad nas bzlog pa'i skabs sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bstan pa'i spyi dgra bsgral ba'i dmigs pa yang gsal btab/ dgug gzhug lhan cig la byas la/ 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor ba dang mnyam du bsad pa'i dmigs pa yang byas mthar bha ya na sa'i tshe lag mthil du dgra bgegs bsam ste bsgral ba'i ro ma 'og gi mgon po'i zhabs 'og ro'i steng du mnan nas nam yang mi thar bar bsam pa mdzad/ spyir sems nad can rnams kyis khro bo bsgom na sems 'tshub byed kyi rgyur 'gyur/ snying nad can gyis skyo shas nges 'byung bskyed pa'i gtam thos pa lta bus kyang sems 'khrugs byed 'ong zhes mkhyen brtses gsung par grag gsung / brag rdzong ma'i phyi khrid kyi me khar gdags pa khams gsum g.yul du bcad pa sogs thams cad lhan du bsgom pa las gang rung re bsgom pa phyag len la med gsung / 'on kyang mahā ka la sogs kyi bsnyen pa bzla zhor la dmigs pa 'di rnams gsal btab na bde mo zhig 'ong / de bzhin du shā sa na spel tshig can 'don zhor la bzlog dmigs rnams byed pa yin/ gsang khrid kyi bdag bskyed skyed chog myur mgyogs pho nya ltar byas na rung / ngag dbang legs grub kyis mdzes rgyan ltar byas 'dug gsung /

de ltar gang ltar byas kyang chog gsung / stong nyid rdo rje'i mkhar gzhug rdo rje gcig gi lte ba'i nang du rten brten pa thams cad bsgom pa yin gsung / thod pa nyi zla'i mkhar gzhug gi dbyangs yig dkar/ gsal byed dmar/ steng gi hūm̐ las dang po a thung de nas ā ring sogs rim par byung ste/ bla ma dam pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad las srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pa'i k+ṣa yig zhabs hūm̐ gi rgyab tu thim par bsam pa yin gsal byed kyi k+ṣa min gsung / 'di dag gi bzlas dmigs byed tshe ngag tu tshig brjod dgos pa rnams rang gis brjod pa yin gsung / zin bris rdo rje'i go khrab dang khrid yig gnyis las khrid yig gtso bor byos gsung / gzhan gyi ting nge 'dzin 'joms pa'i mtshon cha'i skabs rang gi thugs ka nas 'od sngon po 'phro ba yin gsung / mtshon cha tshur 'dus thod pa'i gur khang gi phyi rol du gsungs kyang rdo rje'i gur khang gi phyi rol red gsung / khyod gsang khrid kyi mtshams la bsdod tshe lha dgu po thams cad ye shes gcig gi rang snang yin pas ngo bo la bzang ngan du gtan nas 'dzin mi rung gsung / pu tra ming sring sogs rang rgyud du bzung nas rtsa nang du bsgom na nges par smyo 'bogs sogs 'byung / de'ang rang lus 'od kyi rang bzhin phyag mdzub kyi nang dang snyan gyi nang tshun chad stong song nge ba/ lha rnams kyang dwangs shing gsal ba 'ja' tshon lta bur bsgom pa dang / phyi rol tu dregs pa rgyud gsum du snang ba yang nang gi rtsa yig tu rlung sems rgyu 'grul byas pa'i snang ba yin/ de'ang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi cho 'phrul yin pa'i tshul la yid ches bskyed nas rang las phyi rol tu gyur pa'i lha zhig bsgom pa lta bur mi bsam par rang sems gdod nas dregs pa rgyud gsum gyi ngo bor gnas pa rang ngo shes pa'i 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i ngang nas bsgom na lam du 'gro ba yin gsung /

shā sa na spel tshig can gyi rjes su zhes pa mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ zhes pa'i rjes su ya ma ra dza 'dogs pa yin/ 'khor lo bri sgrub kyi skabs su shā sa na'i pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭ zhes 'don gsung ba bla ma gong ma'i phyag len yin pas de bzhin byed ni dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni gsal bar gsung ba ma mthong / seng gdong ma'i bsnyen pa 'don lugs la'ang 'di 'dra gsung 'dug gsung / spu gri so 'debs kyi skabs su bla ma'i thugs kar sngags phreng thams cad bkod dgos gsung / 'di la dmigs pa gtso che yang ngag nas tshig bton na legs gsung / las mkhan myang 'das kyi rjes su phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa'i bar du bsgom/ de nas phyag mtshan hūm̐ yig tu 'gyur/ de snying gar byon nas gsang rten lus sba byed pa yin gsung / lce byin rlabs skabs/ dbyangs yig g.yon bskor dang / gsal byed g.yas bskor nges par byed dgos gsung / brag rdzong ma'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin na/ spu gri so 'debs kyi dmigs pa gsal btab ste kha zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du longs spyod de/ spyi bo'i rnam snang 'khor bcas bdud rtsis mnyes par bsam ste/ spel tshig kyang / bdag gi 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes dang / mgrin par dbang bya wa shaṃ ku ru ho sogs brjod na las bzhi gang yang 'grub par nges gsung / bstan pa'i spyi dgra gsod pa'i dmigs pa des rnal 'byor sgos dgra gsod pa la sbyor los rung gsung / dmag las byas zhes pa bkod pa byed mkhan dang / dmag dpon dmag rgyab mi lta bu la go rgyu yin gsung / byad ma zhes pa rang la mthu byed mkhan gang yin gyi mi dang mi min gnyis ka la go dgos gsung / sprul pa spro ba'i bzlog pa'i skabs/ bzlog sngags sham bur btags zhes pa bzlas pa mang tsam brjod pa'i mthar nyer gcig tsam 'don pa yin gsung /

rims nad srung ba'i shā sa na'i rjes su/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ rims nad thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pas chog di na me ke sogs 'don mi dgos gsung / bzlog pa'i skabs 'jigs pa'i sgra bsgrags zhes pa hūm̐ sgra dang / gzhan rgyob sod khug sogs sgrogs pa dang / yang sprul spro ba rnams kyis seng ge glang chen khyung sogs kyis rang rang gi nga ro sgrogs par bsam pa yin gsung / dri za'i dmag srin po khros pa lta bu zhes pa rnams rta pa khrab rmog can yin/ gzhan rnams khro bo srin po khros pa lta bur bsam pa las rta pa sogs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med gsung / rig 'dzin gyi dmag ces pa rlung lha'i ming red sgra don ma mthong gsung / sa lha bud med du bsgom pa yin/ ma he ra khar blang ste lcags sreg pa'i sa gzhir brdabs zhes pa lcags bsreg gi sa gzhi gsar pa zhig bsgom nas der rdeb pa red gsung / las grub nas tshe bsod sogs ngom pa'i tshul du khyer zhes pa 'od kha dog sna tshogs pa'i rnam par khyer nas thim par bsam pa yin gsung / dri chu la brten nas rims srung ba'i tshe g.yas par blugs la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gri gug tu bsam/ dkrugs te dri chu'i rdul re re nas shā sa na'i yi ge me 'bar bar bsam nas mid pa yin gsung / skyabs 'gro'i skabs kyi srung 'khor bsgom pa de srung 'khor dngos bsgom tshe snga ma mi dmigs par 'jog pa yin/ de bzhin du kye rdor mngon rtogs kyi skye mched byin rlabs de lus dkyil skye mched kyi lha bsgom tshe snga ma mi dmigs par 'jog pa sogs shes dgos/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum so sor shes na de bzhin gyis/ ma shes tshe gsum po lhan du bton kyang 'gal ba ni med gsung / rbad bsad man ngag ltar bzla gsung pa rbad bsad kyi sngags 'dren pa las dmigs pa mi 'dra ba gzhan ni med gsung / lha mo dang zangs gri can gyi 'bod rbad bsad gsum lhan du 'don pa las rbad bsad logs su phye dka' gsung /

ye shes tshogs bsags snang ba bkag pa'i stong nyid du bsgom pa las 'khor 'das bsgom pa sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor ba gnad che/ zangs gri zhes pa gri gug rno dbal dang ldan pa zhig la zer ba red gsung pa brda snying gi skad yin/ dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug pa'i dgra thabs gsum de bsnyen sgrub las gsum la sbyor du rung gsung / stag zhon gyis 'khu ldog mi 'byung ba'i phyir du liṅga bcas/ de sha khrag dmar nyog ger dmigs nas chos skyong la btab pa las sha khrag dngos su 'jog mi dgos/ snying dkar nag gi mtshams zhes pa snying gi mgo dkar po de nas dmar por gyur pa'i mtshams la zer gsung / gsang khrid sngags phreng g.yas bskor du 'khor zhes pa 'khod red gsung / brag rdzong gi nang du chos 'byung zug pa'i nang phyed mtho tsam man chad khrag gis gang ba'i nang du srung 'khor bsgom pa yin gsung / gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra bdud dang mu stegs kyi klad pa 'gems zhes sgrogs pa yin gsung / srung bya sba ba'i skabs hūm̐ de las rdo rje phra mo nas 'dra ba 'phro pa rang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ chung ngu de las 'phro ba yin gsung / bya ba dang byed pa can gyi bskyed rim zhes pa ni/ lha bskyed pa'i bya ba yod pa dang / de med kyang sems bzung ba la byed las yod pas btags pa red gsungs/ bgegs bzlog pa'i tshe bsgral ba gcig las dmigs mi dgos/ rgyang glu len pa zhes pa thag ring nas glu len pa la zer gsung / mi 'khu ba'i bzlas pa'i skabs/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng spro zhing sna bug g.yas nas thon/ mgon po sogs kyi shangs g.yon nas zhugs par bsgom pa'am/ yang na lha'i sku lus 'od ltar dwangs ba'i bdag nyid can yin pas thugs ka rang nas spros kyang los chog spyir gong ma ltar byed pa 'dra gsung / bzlas dmigs gzhan la'ang des 'gres sbyar chog gsung // ༈ //bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun min 'don tshe mkha' spyod sgrub thabs kyi skyabs yul dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam grangs can bsgom zhes mkhyen brtse'i zhal nas gsungs pa yin gsung /

rdor sems g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa'i tshul gyis yum la 'khyud pa 'di a bhi dha na'i dgongs pa yin gsung / skyabs su 'gro mkhan 'gro ba rigs drug thams cad rnam pa smra shes don go mi'i gzugs sha stag tu bsgom pa yin gsung / rgyud sde gong mar thal mo rlung sems dbu mar 'du ba'i rten 'brel gyis rdo rje thal mo sbyor ba yin/ mchod pa'i lha mo kha dog dmigs bsal med pa thams cad dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhig bsgom gsung / ku sa li'i tshogs bsags skabs/ thod pa chung ngu zhig gis bcus nas chen por blugs te bla ma la phul bar bsam/ rgyun gyi nyams len tshe thod sgyed bdud rtsi'i lhag ma rnams skad cig gis ri gling nyi zla sogs su bsam nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba yin/ dbu ma chen po'i rlung sbyor rnams rang gi ji nus byas chog gsung / bla ma 'od du zhu nas bam̐ yig la thim pas bam̐ yig rgya je cher song nas lus dang gnas khang snod bcud thams cad bam̐ yig gi rang bzhin du gyur nas mthar 'ja' yal ba ltar bsam/ skad cig gis 'od lus zhig grub pa'i rang gi snying gar e e sogs brjod gsung / chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyis yul yul can gyi rnam thar sgo gsum gnyis mtshon/ chos 'byung gi shes rab dga' 'khyil gyis thabs mtshon gsung / sum+bha na'i sngags dang po gnyis kyis sgo mtshams brgyad bskyed/ phyi ma'i tshe srung 'khor bsgom zhing sgo mtshams brgyad las rang 'dra'i sprul pa mang po spros/ dgra bgegs tshar bcad tshur 'dus srung 'khor la thim pas srung 'khor gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam// ༈ //kye rdor la bsdu rim byas kyang 'gal ba cher med snyam gsung // ༈ //rje btsun grags pas chos brgyad spangs nas gang zag gi bdag 'dzin 'dul ba dang / 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du lta bas chos bdag 'dul ba gnad yin gsung / lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi ngang nas lha gsal mi gsal dang /

yang dog che chung sogs don la ma grub par shes par byas nas/ dper na rang gi thugs kar thugs rdo rje'i lte bar bsrung bya sde dge'i yul gru tsam bsam kyang rdo rje che ru ma song yul khams chung ngur ma song ba sogs bsgom nas rtsal sbyong na lta ba 'di bskyed rim la gsal thon pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa yin gsung / nyams rtsub mo byung tshe 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta bas lam du khyer/ de ma nus tshe rtsub nyams 'di bdag gi lam gyi bogs 'don yin par shes nas spro ba bskyed la 'dug cing lta ba bsgom/ tha na'ang sdug sran bskyed la re dogs spang ste bzhag lam khyer nus na bogs 'don gsung // ༈ //bir srung la rtsa 'khor bsgom kyang yi ge bsgom mi dgos/ pho brang lnga yi sa bon ni gsal gdab dgos gsung // ༈ //lam dus kyi khro bo bcu'i rigs bdag la yum yod gsung // ༈ //me 'bar ma'i lung 'don rung gsung // ༈ //mkha' spyod ma'i dbu ma chung ba de la khong thugs shin tu dgyes/ lte ba'i pad+mo rlung lnga'i ti la ka zhes dbu ma che chung gnyis ka'i sngon la dgos gsung / mal lo nas brgyud pa dang gyi ljang lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa gnyis sam gter ma'i brgyud pa gsum dang ldan pa zhes pa lags// ༈ //a mṛ ta brjod tshe rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang sngon g.yas sna tshogs thugs ka dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa dpag tu med pa spros mchod rdzas dang gtor ma'i bgegs thams cad sbyangs/ bsdu na 'od ljang gus ma dag pa rnams sbyang bar bsams kyang rung // ༈ //rgyal ba yangs mgon pas/ khong gis skabs su skyo bsang mdzad de mi dang 'phrad pa dang / mi dang ma 'phrad kyang skyo bsang mdzad pa des kyang bsgom nyams la gnod par gsung pas sgrub pa byed skabs mi dang 'phrad pa dang rnam g.yeng mi byed pa gal che gsung // ༈ //mkha' spyod rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang /

dpyad don nyams len gnyis lhan du bstan pa'ang yod pas dpyad dgos gsung / rnal 'byor ma de nyid spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar la gar stabs mdzad cing yar 'khyug mar 'khyud mdzad pa yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa khams byin gyis brlabs pa'i ched yin gsung / zhar byung gi rdzogs rim la steng 'og gi dga' 'khyil la brten nas bde stong skyed par bsam pa de steng 'og gi 'khor lo la brten nas bde stong sgrub pa zhes pa dang don gcig gsung / sngags mchod phyag rgya ma bshad pa rnams la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bca' bar mdzad gsung / rang gi snying gar e 'og ma kha rgyab la bstan steng ma kha mdun la lta ba/ gcig mdun dang gcig rgyab nas bton chog pa lta bu yin/ rnam snang he ru ka dkar po g.yas 'khor lo thugs kar 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i tshul gyis bzhengs pa he ru ka'i chas can yum med// ༈ //'khor lo'i rtsibs bar brgyad du dgra bgegs brgyad dmigs pa yin/ dbang lha spyan 'dren byed rtsa rgyud dang sbyar nas 'od nag por gsungs pa yang snang / 'od zer sna tshogs su spros kyang rung gsung / spyir 'od zer sna tshogs spro bar nyi zer las bshad/ dbang lha rnams zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par bsgyur tshe bdud bzhi'i gdan kyang dgos/ rang zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yin tshe rigs bdag kyang zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa dang / rang g.yas brgyad rdo rje g.yon brgyad dril bu 'dzin pa yin tshe rigs bdag kyang de dang 'dra/ rang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yin na rigs bdag kyang phyag gnyis pa yin no/ ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs srung 'khor gyi phyi nang kun gang ba spyan 'dren pa yin gsung / rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes zhes pa dag pa'i zhing du skye bar bsam pa'o/ /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bskyal ba de don gyis mi bskyod pa'i zhing yin pas de bzhin bsams kyang rung //

༈ //lce byin rlabs ni/ rang gi gre phug tu raṃ dmar nag lug gi ril ma tsam las me 'bar te tha mal gyi lce gzhob thul gyis bsreg de nas hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga par gsal ba'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar po nyal thab tu gnas pa'i mgo gre phug dang zhabs kyu lce'i rtse mo'i phyogs la bstan pa/ de'i mthar ā li kā li'i mgo gre phug tu bstan nas zo dkris ltar g.yas bskor du bskor ba/ rwa rnams kyi nang du rtse mo nas mar oṃ shrī mahā ka la ya ma ma badz+ra dzi hwa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ku ru swā hā zhes pa'i sngags phreng brtsegs ma me 'bar bzhin pa dmar shar re ba/ de dag las 'bar ba'i me lces gnod byed dang ma dag pa thams cad gzhob thul bsregs par bsams la gong gi sngags bdun nam gsum brjod mthar rdo rje yig 'bru dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rdo rje nag po chen po'i ljags srab pa zhal gyi dkyil 'khor kheb pa zhig tu gyur bar bsam mo/ /sngags 'di bgrang na lce la phan nges gsung // ༈ //kye rdor lam dus kyi dbang len tshe dbang rdzas kyi lha la'ang lus dkyil gsal gdab dgos gsung / gzhal yas khang gi zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa zhes pa dril bu la zla phyed btags pa rlung gis bskyod pa la zer gsung // ༈ //sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs 'di tshe sgrub la shin tu zab gsung / khyung khra'i bsnyen pa grub na khyed la phan nges gsung // ༈ //mkha' spyod ma'i tshes bcu'i skabs gtor mgron spyan drangs ba mdun bskyed la thim par bsam nas gtor ma 'bul ba yin/ cho ga la'ang de bzhin te 'jam mgon kun blos phaiṃ zhes gtor mgron gyi lha spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim zhes mdun bskyed la bstim nas de nas gtor sngags 'don par gsung yod gsung // ༈ //lha dang bla ma la dngos grub zhu ba'i tshe kham chung mi rung ste/ sngon gnyan lo tsā bas tshogs mdzad tshe grub thob brgyad bcu'i zhal gzigs dngos grub gang 'dod gsung pa la/

ngas bod du lha khang mang po zhig bzhengs rgyu yin pas lha khang re la srung ma re yod pa'i dngos grub zhu zhes zhus pas dngos grub len ma shes pa la bzhad cing bsting ba mdzad/ dngos grub de rtsal yang khong gis lha khang rnams mang po ma grub pas srung ma rnams slar rgya gar btang dgos byung bas dngos grub chen po zhu thub dgos gsung // ༈ //gnas gzhal yas khang bcud lhar shes pa'i 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba dang ldan na gsang sgrogs kyi ltung ba gtan nas med/ 'khor 'das dbyer med 'di rtogs na gang ltar byas kyang bde mo zhig yod/ lam dus sbyang gzhi sbyong byed zhib tu shes los dgos/ lta ba la nges shes rnyed tshe de'i ngang nas bton na der ma 'dus pa med/ re re nas gu dog ma byas na legs gsung / 'khor 'das dbyer med 'di la go ba legs po zhig byung nas bzung ste dpyad sgom dang 'jog sgom gnyis las 'jog sgom 'di gnad che/ dpyad sgom bzang yang rnam rtog red gsung / lus dkyil 'di spyir bum dbang gi lam yin kyang sku dbyibs rnam pa bde ba rang bzhin stong gsal ngo bo zung 'jug zhes pa ltar dbang gong ma'i lta ba 'dren nus pa zhig byung tshe rlung dang gtum mo sogs lam gzhan ma bsgoms kyang chog bsgom mi dgos pa lam 'jug ldog gi gnad kyis yin/ de'ang lam 'jug ldog zhes pa dper na nges 'byung dang byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa zhig rgyud la skyes tshe snang gsum la ma sbyang yang dang po nas rgyud gsum gyi nyams len la 'jug rung ba lta bu dang / lam gzhan la'ang des 'gres sbyar nas shes dgos pa yin/ mnyam bzhag tu bum dbang gi lam gyis rtogs pa 'byongs tshe/ rjes thob tu lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum skyong dgos/ mnyam bzhag tu bum dbang gi lam bsgom pas dbang gong ma'i ye shes 'dren nus na rjes thob tu bde stong chen po'i lta ba'i ngang skyong ba sogs yin/

de'ang ye shes bzhi po bum dbang gi lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum phyi yul gyi steng du skye/ rang byung gi ye shes nang sems kyi steng du skye/ bde stong gi ye shes bar lus kyi steng du skye/ bde stong rgya che ba phyi nang bar gsum ka'i steng du skye ba yin pas de ngo shes par bya dgos/ de'ang khyod kyis lus dkyil bsgom tshe lus la bde stong gi ye shes skye na lam gzhan bsgom mi dgos pa lta bu yin gsung // ༈ //bla ma blo gros kyi spyan la/ rab 'byams zhing kun khyab par sku khrus gsol zhes pa'i tshe mkha' khyab kyi rgyal ba sras bcas la rang gi sgrib pa sbyong ba'i phyir khrus gsol ba dang / ma dag pa'i 'gro ba thams cad la khrus byas pas ma rig pa'i rab rib sbyangs nas dag pa ye shes kyi spyan thob par bsams la blo stobs chen po bskyed na phan par sems gsung / rang sems chos skur ngo 'phrod sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos sku dang / rang gi sems/ gshin po'i rnam shes gsum dbye ba med pa'i nges shes bskyed nas/ de'i ngang nas gshin po la 'pho ba btab tshe shi po rnams mgo g.yog gi mi 'dug snyam pa'i yid ches zhig 'byung gi 'dug gsung / lha spyan 'dren byed kyi 'od zer sna sgo nas spro zhes pa'i dmigs bsal med pa rnams la snying ga rang nas spros kyang chog pa 'dra gsung / kha zas grib can za dgos pa dang / mi dam nyams dang 'phrad pa sogs rnam rtog ngan pa skyes tshe/ rang nyid kyi rnam rtog 'di las phyi rol du gyur pa'i grib dang gdon bgegs sogs ni med/ rang snang ma dag par snang ba ni gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi rtog pa 'dis byas pa yin/ rang ngo shes na sku dang ye shes kyang 'di las log na med par nges pa'i lta ba la nges shes bskyed de ched du bos pa'i mgron slebs pa ltar rang gi nyams len gyi gsal 'debs yin snyam pa'i ngang nas rkyen ngan thog brdzis dang /

'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba la bogs 'don byed dgos pas ma 'phyug gsung // ༈ //lam dus kyi dbang len pa na/ swā bha was stong nyid bsgom pas 'chi ba sbyong / gdan gyis skye gnas sbyong / phyag mtshan gyi sa bon gyis mtshon pas bar srid sbyong / sku 'grub pas lus dang / skye mched byin rlabs kyis lus nar son pa sbyong / ye shes pa gzhug pas bsam pa dang / rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pas mnga' thang la longs spyod pa sbyong ba yin gsung / rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gnyis ka la rigs bdag yod de dkon mchog lhun grub kyis kye rdor sbyin sreg tu'ang bshad do gsung / sbyin bsreg byed tshe til 'di sdig sgrib sbyong byed yin pas rnam pa kun tu sdig sgrib bstim dgos pa 'dra/ de bdud rtsir bsgyur ba yid kyis bsam pas kyang rung gsung / lam dus kyi ye shes pa spyan drangs te tshur bstim pa'i tshe/ lha lha la thim pa'i tshe srung 'khor sogs rten kyang rten la thim par bsam gsung / lus dkyil legs par gsal btab nas sku dbyibs sogs dbang bzhi'i gnad tshang bar shes pa'i ngang nas dbang len pa kho na nyams len byas na lam gzhan mi dgos par 'jog pa lam 'jug ldog gi gnad yin zhes dpal ldan don 'grub gsung gsung // ༈ //gzhan gyis log sgrub byung tshe khong rnams 'khrul nas rang dbang med pa yin/ nga la bla mas 'khor 'das thams cad sems su ngo sprad pas med snang 'khrul ba'i ngang du 'gro mi nyan bsam nas rang snang 'khrul ba lam du khyer thub dgos gsung // ༈ //las mgon gyi bstod pa gnod sbyin yab yum ma o rgyan chen pos mdzad pa yin/ mal los mdzad pa dpal ldan phrin las kun rdzogs sogs red gsung / mgon po'i gsang khrid skabs rbad bsad bzla dgos gsungs pa rnams su'ang 'bod rbad bsad gsum lhan du bton na nyes pa ci yang med/ dper na shā sa na la de gsum ga tshang yang gang du'ang 'don rung ba lta bu'o gsung /

tshad med bzhi'i skabs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po'i sne la sgo ma seng gdong ma 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba zhes khrid yig na 'dug rung khong gis bsgom dus 'od zer dkar po'i sne la sgo ma spro ba yin gsung / khyod kyis bzlas dmigs skabs ye shes kyi me lces gdon bgegs bsreg par bsam/ de yang the tshom skyes na zhi mi thub pas rang sems 'khrul ba'i snang ba la gdon bgegs shar ba ma gtogs phyi rol na med pa'i nges shes snying nas bskyed/ brag srin mos rje btsun la bag chags 'thug pa'i rgyu sogs zhus pa ltar rang nyid kyis gdon bgegs phyi rol na yod par bzung na gnod kyang gnod yong / rang sems 'khrul ba'i snang ba las phyi rol na gtan nas med pa'i nges shes skyes na gdon bgegs kyi 'tshe ba mi 'byung ste/ khong la 'tshub snang mang po shar tshe/ srid pa gsum gyi gnod byed thams cad lag mthil du bsam/ de'ang rang sems kyi 'khrul snang yin par shes nas bzlog pa byas tshe bzlog 'gro ba la tshegs mi 'dug gsung / snang ba sems sgrub 'di kha tsam du ma shor bar nges pa gting nas skyes na 'khrul nang gi gnod pa zhi ba la dka' tshegs med/ dngos po'i gnas tshul la gdon bgegs phyi rol na med pa'i phyir gsung / mgon po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bla brgyud rnams mdun mkhar zhal rang la phyogs nas bsgom// ༈ //'jam dbyangs sbags sgrub rdor sems ltar rang gi spyi bo nas zhal mdun gzigs bsgom// ༈ //mgon po lha bcu gcig la rang yin pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin dgos gsung / 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba dang ldan na bskyed rdzogs gang bsgom kyang legs pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba med na gang bsgom kyang phan pa med/ snod bcud lhar bsgom kyang lha min pa zhig la yin par bsam pa tsam las gdod nas lha yin pa la yin par ngo shes pa lta bu'i yid ches pa sems tshim mo zhig mi 'ong gsung /

bsnyen mtshams la bsdod tshe sems brel du mi 'jug pa gnad che/ mtshams la bsdod lugs kyang phyi dam la nang lhod pa zhig dgos/ a ma la gtsang sbra shin tu gal che bas kun spyod ma lhod/ 'jam bstan kho rang nas tshe bsnyen bgrangs na phan gsung / khyod kyis khro mo rme brtsegs dang khyung khra gnyis la nyams len gyis gsung // ༈ //lam dus kyi 'byung bzhi'i rlung dkyil la 'chang zung dang chog ma gnyis la ba dan yam̐ yig gis mtshan pa ljang gu gsum bsgom gsung / me dkyil gyi leb gsum la raṃ yig dmar po re re gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin bsam/ chu dkyil maṇ+ḍal chus gang ba lta bu'i steng du bum pa dkar pos mtshan pa/ sa dkyil gyi phyogs bzhi la rdo rje phyed pa bzhi rtsa ba chog la zug pa rtse mo phyir 'phyar ba/ lte ba na laṃ yig lang thabs su yod pa/ 'khor lo chos 'khor rtsibs brgyad lte ba 'bur ba rtsibs su rtsis pa'i tshe rtsibs bcu zer ba red/ rtser rdo rje phyed pa tog rin po che zur brgyad pas byas pa yin lags/ bar srid mtshon byed yig 'bru mgo thur bstan oṃ zhabs ma byas nas yod/ khyi'i shas gti mug sel/ gnyid chung / rta shas 'dod chags sel rig pa rno/ mi'i shas zhe sdang sel sems stobs dang ldan zhing mthu che/ glang po che'i shas khrag dog sel gzhan thams cad dbang du 'du/ ba lang gi shas nga rgyal sel snying rje skye/ bdud rtsi lngas ye shes lnga'i rtogs pa rgyud la 'char/ sha chen gyis rlung sel/ rak+tas mkhris pa/ mi bskyod pas bad kan/ byang sems kyis khrag rnam snang gis 'dus pa'i nad sel lo/ /nad thams cad sel mdangs dang ldan/ dus min gyi 'chi ba mi 'byung tshe ring ba sogs kyi dngos grub thob pa sogs gsung / don bsdu na gsum ste/ tshe dang lus kyi bcud len du 'gyur ba dang / dug lnga rang gnas su zhi zhing / lam lnga rgyud la bskyed pa dang / dbang bzhi'i lta ba lam du slong bas 'bras bu grub pa'i dgos pa'o gsung //

༈ //kha ba'i rigs ni/ nim pa/ tig ta/ tsha ba/ sga skya/ pho ril dang prod sman sogs/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi/ shing mngar/ rgu 'brum/ mngar ba/ se 'bru/ se yab/ ltar bu/ skyu ru ra sogs skur ba/ lan tshwa/ rgya tshwa/ rgyam tshwa/ dwa tshwa/ kha ru tshā sogs tshwa sna/ ba ru ra/ li shi/ sug+mel/ gla sgang sogs brka ba// ༈ //ku sa li'i tshogs gsag skabs/ chos thams cad rang sems skad cig ma 'di'i cho 'phrul du thag bcad/ rang lus dngos su btang ba dang rang gis dmigs pa gnyis ka sems snang tsam yin pas de gnyis la khyad ci'ang med pa'i tshul la nges pa rnyed par byas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kha tsam min par snying nas skyed/ rang la nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs bskyed pa'i gnod byed dgra 'dre gdon bgegs rnams pha mar shes pa'i snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa bskyed/ bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dus skad cig 'di nyid la rdzogs par bya'o snyam pa'i blo stobs dang bcas rang lus kyi mchod sbyin byas te/ de las byung ba'i dge ba rnams rang la gnod par byed pas thogs drangs pa'i sems can rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i rgyur snying nas bsngo ba byed/ rang gi lhag bsam dag pa dang / bla ma'i byin rlabs dang rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pas de bzhin du gyur cig snyam pa'i bden stobs smon lam 'debs/ de'ang rang gi nad 'di dwangs ba'i ched yin snyam pa'i rang 'dod dang bla ma la sangs rgyas su ma mthong zhing snang ba sems su thag ma chod pa sogs yid gnyis re dogs kyi rtog ngan dang bcas te kha tsam gyis grangs mang po brjod pa la dgos pa til 'bru tsam yang med/ snying nas dad pa dang snying rje yid ches bskyed la tshul 'di la nan tan snying por sgrub na 'khrul snang gi sdug bsngal zhi ba la dka' tshegs med pa yin/ ji bzhin byung na zla ba gcig gis chog

the tshom med gsung / mdor na mi 'dod mi legs pa thams cad rang gi re dogs 'khu 'khrigs gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog ngan 'dis byas pa ma gtogs phyi rol na med pa'i tshul 'di blo la nges par gyis gnad shin tu che bas ma brjed gsung / 'di bsogs lugs mdun bskyed gcig la tshogs mchod 'bul ba bzhin du/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gcig gi nang du ku sa li'i tshogs bsag pa yin gsung / rkyen ngan na tsha sogs byung tshe nges 'byung snying rje sogs skye sla zhing / de lta bu'i dus bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bskyed la rang lus kyi tshogs mchod gong ltar nyams su blangs na nges par skyed thon pa 'byung / kha tsam la ni snying po med pa khyod dpyod ldan yin pas los shes/ des na gnad du 'gro bar nges pa zhig gyis dang bslu ba med gsung / shes rab lta ba la thag chod pa'i nges pa zhig yod na thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa'i gsal snang 'dren zhing / bskyed rdzogs gang bsgom kyang phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'byung / shes rab lta bas ma zin pa'i bskyed rdzogs rkyang pa ni/ sdud pa las/ dmus long dmigs bu med pa bye ba phrag brgya yis/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa dang 'dra/ thabs kyis ma zin pa'i shes rab rkyang pas kyang mi phan te/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba de ni yongs su ma rdzogs par/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de'ang lta ba rtogs pa'i mthus bskyed rim la gsal snang 'phel ba sogs thabs shes gnyis gcig grogs su gcig 'char ba zhig ma byung na gnad 'phyug pa yin/ dper na mgon po'i gsang khrid skabs mgrin par bla ma he ru ka mthe'u chung gi tshad tsam bsgom pa'i thugs kar nyi dkyil yungs kar gleb pa lta bu'i steng du hūm̐ yig spu shad kyis bris pa lta bu zhig gsal btab/ de'i mthar de wa pi tsu/ de'i mthar mgon po'i bsnyen pa sogs bsgom pa yang lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med la nges pa zhig med na dod tsam ma gtogs ji bzhin pa mi 'byung /

che chung yangs dogs snga phyi ring thung gsal mi gsal sogs don la ma grub par shes pa'i lta ba dang ldan pa'i ngang nas 'di 'dra bsgom na ji lta ba bzhin 'byung ba yin pas 'di gnad che gsung / stong nyid legs par rtogs na 'khor ba pa la snying rje rtsol med du skye/ snying rje bcos min skyes na lta ba rtogs pa'i rkyen byed pa bzhin du lta ba rtogs na des bskyed rim la gsal snang 'dren tshul yang de dang gnad gcig pa yin gsung / de yang bar chad ngag la 'jug pas ngag mi 'chor bar mchu btsum ste lan mi bya/ brdas sgo nas brtags te/ de la lus ngag gi brda gnyis/ dang po la rtsa ba dang yan lag gi brda bzhi bzhi/ lus dkyil mchod pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la tshul bzhin du bslab na phyi rol gyi sbyin sreg ma grub kyang mi dgos zhes ngor mkhan po sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis gsung yod gsung / nang mchod byin rlabs tshe/ me dkyil gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa zer yang raṃ yig bsgom dgos gsung / khyod kyis bgegs dang bar chad sel ba/ las ngan pa'i sgrib pa sbyong ba sogs gang la'ang ku sa li'i tshogs gsog 'di las lhag pa med med nges yin/ 'di la phan yon tshul bzhin 'byung mi 'byung khyod rang la rag las te/ ji skad du/ 'di kos phan dang phan pa'i gzugs brnyan du/ /'gyur ba de dang de 'dra'i gang zag la/ /rag mod brtsams pa'i dge ba bcos min de/ /'gro kun thub pa'i ye shes rtogs phyir bsngo/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na kha tsam min par snying nas lam 'di nyams su len nus na 'phags pa'i sa mngon du 'gyur ba'ang srid gsung // ༈ //kye rdor dngos sta gnyis po nyin gcig la 'don rgyu de/ rgyud sde kun btus kyi dbang gnang mkhan rnams kyis phyag len de 'dra mdzad de byed dgos tshe/ sta gon gyi lha rnams slar spyan ma drangs kyi bar du zhes brjod na legs/

slob ma sta gon mtshan gcig la tshar dgos pa'i dbang gis zhag chod dgos pa yin/ gzhan la rgyun mtshan ma nges// ༈ //'khor 'das dbyer med bsgom par byed pa la thog mar bla ma la sangs rgyas su mthong ba'i mos gus zhig dgos te de med na bla ma'i gsung la yid ches mi skye/ de nas 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems las log na med pa'i nges shes dper na lan tshwa chur bskyur ba'i tshe chu las logs su lan tshwa mi rnyed pa ltar sems las phyi rol du gyur pa'i yul med par thag chod na/ dper na stag phyi rol na med na de yod par 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi skye ba ltar phyi rol yul du 'dzin pa mi skye la/ gzung ba med na der 'dzin med/ /ces pa ltar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yang mi skye/ de yang 'phags pa ma thob bar gzung 'dzin gtan nas med pa dka' rung ha lam gzung 'dzin dang bral ba sems rig pa gcer bur thon tshe/ de'i ngang la bcas bcos dang dgag sgrub med par bzhag na dga'/ sems gsal le hrig ge dang / de'i ngo bo stong pa sogs dpyad pa mang po byed pa de rnam rtog yin pas chod chen po med/ tshul 'di la yid ches legs pa zhig skyes nas bzung ste dpyad sgom 'jog sgom gnyis las phyi ma gal che/ tshar pa mkhyen brtses/ lab lab mang po'i kha na med/ /ces gsung pa de gnad 'di lta bu la dgongs pa yin/ lta ba 'di'i gnad ji lta ba bzhin zin pa'i tshe slob ma la lam dbang bskur ba'i tshe rang kye rdor lus tshad tsam bsgom pa'i thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma'i mdun du slob ma gnyer lnga po thams cad kyai rdo rje'i lus tshad tsam re bsgom kyang yangs dog sogs mi bde ba med pa khrig ger 'grigs pa zhig 'byung ba yin/ de lta bu'i gnad zin pa'i tshe/ snang ba sems su sgrub pa dang / sgyu mar sgrub pa/ rten 'brel du sgrub pa/ brjod bral du sgrub pa rnams kyang rim ldan mi dgos par thams cad chab gcig la rtogs shing yid ches par 'byung /

klu sgrub kyi lta rim rtogs tshul gyi tshig bcad dang sbyar na 'grigs pa yin gsung / 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems gcig nyid de dang der shar ba ma gtogs phyi rol na med par thag chod na rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de yang kha tsam tshig tsam go yul tsam min par ljen lhang nger mthong ba'i tshe 'khor gsum gyi spros pa thams cad zhi nas/ gshis spros bral gyi ngang la blo bya bral bzhag na/ spros pa thams cad rang sems bsgom du med pa'i rang mdangs la thim ste nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtogs zhes bya ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i mnyam gzhag la gsal snang thon na/ rjes thob kyi skabs su gzugs thams cad snang stong 'khor 'das dbyer med/ sgra thams cad grags stong 'khor 'das dbyer med sogs su rtogs na/ tshong pa gser gling du phyin na sa rdo phal pa mi rnyed pa ltar sgom logs na brtsal mi dgos par/ gang shar chos kyi rol par mthong na mnyam bzhag gis rjes thob la bogs 'thon te legs po zhig 'ong / 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems 'di'i cho 'phrul yin pa'i nges shes skyed/ sems gsal rig sgyu ma lta bu la rkyen bzang ngan gyi stobs kyis gang du bsgyur yang chog rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thogs pa ma mchis pa'i mos gus yang yang bskyed nas bden stobs brjod pa 'di goms su bcug na ji lta ba bzhin 'grub par 'gyur ba la the tshom mi dgos zhes gsung / nyams thag bdag gi chos kyi gegs/ nad rims gdon bgegs byad kha rbod gtong rmis ltas mtshan ltas ngan pa dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa la sogs pa srid zhi'i rgyud pa thams cad skad cig nyid la gtan med du zhi bar gyur cig tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod dbang thang rlung rta lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig

mthar thug nye sras brgyad kyi thugs bskyed smon lam dang / mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan 'gro don phrin las thams cad bdag gis 'grub par shog cig/ ༈ //rta mgrin gyi glang chen gyi ko rlon dang / zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi gnyis rkang lag g.yon ma gnyis phrag thog tu 'phang nas mgo g.yas su bstan nas yod/ khrag gi thig le mkhur bar rgyug gri khrag dang mkha' khrag gnyis yin/ thal chen gyi tshom bu lag sor lnga'i rtser thal ba brkus nas lus la lnga tshom bkod pa yin// ༈ //mkha' spyod lus dkyil skabs bam̐ yig gi srog gi a dang / de'i cha shas ya ra la wa bzhi ste yi ge lnga'i cha dang ldan pa de skad cig gis lha lnga'i rnam par bskyed pa las dbus su a dang / phyogs bzhir ya ra la wa bsgom nas de nas lha bskyed pa lta bu yin/ kye rdor lus dkyil gyi rtsa yig lhar gsal 'debs pa dang tshul mtshungs gsungs/ yid bzlas tshe lus dkyil sngags su bsgyur nas lte bar phabs te klog pa'i tshul byed pa las lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs kar sngags phreng gsal btab nas yid bzlas byed pa rang gzhung la med gsung / dngul chu dharma bha dras kyang bshad 'dug pas tshar lugs thun min min pa 'dra gsung / mkha' spyod bdud rtsi myong ba'i dmigs pa des sbyang gzhi bza' btung byed pa sogs kyi skabs su yang rgyas btab nas nyams su blang na legs gsung / yid bzlas skabs rtsa gsum bsgom nas dug gsum gyi rtog pa sbyong ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas rlung re bsal ba 'di rang lugs kyi zab gnad zhig yin gsung / tshogs mchod go rim ljon shing dang bstun kyang legs/ skye mched lha rnams glu gar gyis tshim byed sngon dus 'brog mi'i dus sogs glu dngos su len srol yod/ da lta tshogs glu blang na legs/ kol+la lan gnyis bton kyang rung / tshogs mchod bgo dus phud bla ma yi dam la phul/ de nas srung ma la 'bul ba sogs byed pa las cha gsum du bgo mi dgos gsung /

bla mchod dang tshogs mchod sbrags na de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i rjes su tshogs mchod 'bul/ dngos gzhi tshim pa drug song nas ku sa li'i tshogs bsags gyis gsung / de nas tshogs mchod rnams gang 'os byas kyang los chog gsung // ༈ //las dang po pas bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres nas gnas lugs kyi ngang du 'jog pa dgos kyang / brtan pa thob pa rnams la ni/ kong sprul rin po ches/ rje bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems/ /gser bum dang rdza bum gyi nam mkha' bzhin/ /gsal rig stong gsum klong du gcig /bsre bsnan dang dgag sgrub ma dgos par/ /dran stong las logs su med par rtogs/ /mchog gi dngos grub byas kyang mchog /dmyal bar song yang 'gyod pa med/ /bla ma bya ba'ang rang sems kho na yin gyi rang sems las gzhan pa'i bla ma zhig zur na med pa shes tsa na/ rang sems gnyug ma'i rang zhal la cer gyis bltas pas/ bla ma 'du bral ye nas mi 'dug pas phyi rol du bla ma gshegs pa'i mya ngan gdung ba sogs kyang 'khrul pa tsam du zad do/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi sgrib g.yog dang bral ba'i sems gsal stong zung 'jug zhes pa'i gsal ba rnam rtog gi gsal ba 'di ma yin par/ gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba'i rtog med kyi gsal ba zhig la zer ba yin gsung / ma bcos pa'i gnas lugs la bcos ma'i bzo ma byed/ rnam rtog gi yo lang la mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin du ma re zhes gsung / 'khor 'das dbyer med bsgom pa 'di rkyen dang bsre thub na shin tu legs/ dus rgyun sgom pa las rkyen ngan byung tshe de dang bsres nas bsgom na bogs 'don mchog tu 'gyur ba yin pas gal che gsung // ༈ //'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba gnad don snying por dril ba nas bstan na/ snang ba sems su sgrub pa'i dpe brgyad kyi sgo nas 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems su thag chod/ de yang snang ba rang sems yin pa'i go ba yul le ba de 'dra ma yin par/

snang ba sems su ji lta bar ngo 'phrod tsa na/ dper na lan tshwa chu la thim pa chu las logs su phye mi shes pa ltar sems las gzhan pa'i snang ba mi rnyed par 'gro/ de ltar gyur tshe/ gzung ba med pas der 'dzin med/ /ces pa'i tshul gyis nang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa med par go gzung 'dzin gnyis ka'i sgrib g.yog dang bral tshe sems ma bcos pa'i gnas lugs mi mthong ka med yin pas sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba/ ngo bo stong pa gnyis nam yang dbyer mi phyed pa zung du 'jug pa brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i nges shes gting nas skyes te/ spros bral dang brjod bral kha tshig tsam du ma shor bar don rang thog nas ngo legs par 'phrod nas/ gshis spros bral gyi steng la blo bya bral bzhag nas 'khor gsum gyi rtog tshogs thams cad bsgom du med pa'i rang mdangs la thim nas/ nam mkha' lta bu'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur pa 'di la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtogs zer snyam lags/ de'ang dpyad 'jog gang byed rang gi rgyud tshod dang bstun te/ sems ha cang rgod drag na 'jog bsgom la gtso bor byed/ gnas cha shas che zhing bying rmugs 'dres na/ dpyad bsgom gtso bor byed dgos/ de ltar grim lhod ran pos bskyang bas gnyug ma gshis kyi gnas lugs mngon du gyur pa la sangs rgyas zhes ming btags pa lags/ mdor na gzhi dus kyi chos sku sems ma bcos gnyug mar gnas pa de lam dus kyi chos sku sems ma bcos par bzhag pa'i thabs kyis nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras dus kyi chos sku sems nyid ma bcos pa'i rang ngo ljen par shes pa la sangs rgyas zhes ming btags pa yin gyi/ sems las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas ga shed na yod na rang re rnams kyis len kyang mi thub/ blang kyang 'dre bar dka'o/ /de ltar mnyam gzhag gi nyams len de rjes thob la khyer tshul/ mig gi lam du gzugs gang dang gang snang ba thams cad snang tsam nyid nas snang stong 'khor 'das dbyer med/

rna ba'i lam du sgra ci dang ci grag pa thams cad grag tsam nyid nas grag stong 'khor 'das dbyer med/ sems kyi yul du rnam rtog bzang ngan gang shar yang shar tsam nyid nas rig stong 'khor 'das dbyer med du rtogs nas gang shar chos sku'i yo lang / gang snang 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rol par shar nas/ bsgom bya ba zur du rtsal mi dgos par gang shar gang snang gi steng du bcas bcos ma byas par bzhag na chog pa zhig 'byung ba lags/ 'dod chags kyi gnyen po mi sdug pa/ zhe sdang la byams pa/ gti mug la rten 'brel/ phrag dog gi gnyen por bdag gzhan mnyam pa bsgom kyang gnyen po phyogs re ba yin/ lta ba 'dis nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gyur zhing / 'gyur tshul yang rtsa ba drung nas phyungs shing slar mi skye ba'i chos can du byed pa lags/ snang ba thams cad sems su legs par go tshe/ sems kyi rang bzhin spros bral la nges shes skyes na a mas mngon sum du rjes su bzung bas sems kyi rang bzhin la bzang du 'gro rgyu dang / bdud dmag bye ba phrag brgyas gnod pa byas kyang rang bzhin la ngan du 'gro rgyu spu tsam med pa'i gnad shes nas lta ba'i ngang du 'jog thub na phan gnod byed pa'i lha 'dre thams cad rang sems 'khrul bas btags pa ma gtogs don la med par shes na 'phrul snang gi gnod pa gang gis kyang mi brdzi ba red ces gsung / zangs mdog dpal ri'i rten dang brten par bcas pa gsal btab nas/ nga la khyed rnams lkog tu gyur kyang khyed rnams la bdag lkog tu ma gyur pas mkhyen brtse'i gzigs pa da lta nyid du 'jug par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab tshe rgyal gdon gyi gnod pa zhi 'gro bar 'dug gsung / khyod khar sang sems dwangs skabs dang / da lta rmi lam sogs 'tshub skabs gnyis ka sems las phyi rol du ma grub pa 'dra bas gnyis ka 'khrul ba yin/ sems kyi ngo bo la snga mas phan spu tsam yang ma btags la/

phyi mas gnod pa cung zad tsam yang byas pa med/ rang gi dga' sdug re dogs kyi rtog pa 'di bcad nas spros bral gyi lta ba'i klong du bzhag na rkyen ngan gang gis kyang brdzi mi nus pa yin gsung / sbyor sgrol zhes pa'i don mthar thug gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bsgral nas chos kyi dbyings su sbyor ba zhes pa yin zhes shāka mchog gsung // ༈ //rtsa rlung 'khrul 'khor sbyang rgyu la phyag mo legs po zhig 'dug gsung / bla ma blo gros kyi spyan 'di la mig 'byed 'dis phan dgongs pa zhig 'dug ste khong gi mig 'byed kyi sngags 'di 'phreng skor cha shas bton pa la yang de ma thag phan thogs 'byung gin 'dug gsung / 'di'i mjug na mig sbyong ba'i gzungs zer ba zhig 'dug pa de gsung na'ang phan par sems gsungs// ༈ //khyed kyis yi dam gyi lha du ma brten kyang blo gtad gcig la byed lugs ni/ khyod kyis gos mdog dmar po byas pa dang / de ser por bsgyur yang khyed rang gi ngo bo gcig yin pa bzhin du lha du ma bsten kyang ngo bo gcig kho na yin pas/ yi dam gang bsten kyang gcig spang nas gcig brten pa lta bur bsam mi rung gsung / yi dam thams cad bla mar ma 'dus pa med pas/ bla ma gcig po la kun 'dus par bsam nas blo gtad bla ma la byas na los chog gsung // ༈ //bla ma blo gros kyi spyan 'di la mig 'byed kyi skabs su nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal nas ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan par bya snyam pa'i thugs bskyed mdzad na phan par dgongs gsung // ༈ //'khrul 'khor sbyong skabs/ dri chu bar pa snod zhig tu bsag la/ lus ril po bkru thub pa zhig bsag la/ de mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin du shes par byas nas/ 'bru gsum brjod cing rtsa ba'i bla ma la lan gsum 'bul/ de bzhin du yi dam la lan gsum 'bul/ rang gis lan gsum 'thung /

de nas lus thams cad bkru bar byas na rtsa gnyen pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa yod/ 'khrul 'khor dngos kyi lag len yig cha zhal gsal bas de bzhin byas na 'thus/ rlung bum can bzung na nad la phan kyang re zhig khyod kyis rang la gnod byed gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed cing mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag po dang bcas te ku sa li'i tshogs mchod 'di la nan tan gyis/ skyabs 'gro'i skabs mdun du dgra bo bsgom pa de theg chen gyi lugs la pha ma bas kyang dgra bo snying rje'i yul du byed dgos pa yin pa'i don yin/ gnod byed la snying rje bskyed gsung / ma cig zha ma'i rnam thar bzhin sdug bsngal 'di bag chags sad byed yin pa'ang srid gsung // ༈ //kye rdor lam dus kyi sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi 'od kyis bcud thams cad lha dgu'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ de nas rjes su sems can gcig mthong na'ang 'di lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor yin bsam pa las sems can lha dgur bsam pa lta bur min gsung / sras bcas ma'i 'grel par/ so sor spang bya spong ba dang / bslab bya rnams la slob pa'i sgo nas brtan por gzung / zhes dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni sangs rgyas kyi rnal 'byor te rnam snang gi rigs las skyes pa'i skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa de nyid deng nas zhes pa dang / rdo rje'i rigs mchog ces pa rigs kyi bdag po yin par bstan/ de nyid la chen po zhes bod par 'os te bla ma chen po zhes 'bod pa bzhin no zhes dang / rin chen rigs mchog rigs kyi bdag po ste/ rin chen 'byung ldan chen po yin/ dam tshig gang zhig gdul bya'i snying la 'bab pa yid du 'ong ba de la zhes dang / byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i thabs mkhas pa chen po las byung ba'i rigs lnga'i nang nas pad+ma'i rigs mchog ste/ 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig yang dag pa la las kyi rigs mchog ste phrin las kyi ngo bo don yod grub pa chen po'i dam tshig la yan lag bdun pa'i 'grel par byang chub spyod mchog skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi yid du 'ong ba zhes dang /

'gos kyi stong thun las/ rin chen lta bu la bdun te/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan zhing rang bzhin gyis tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang / mkhas pa gzhan la phan 'dogs pa dang / sgrin pas gzhan la gnod pa mi byed pa dang / shes rab che bas chos thams cad kyi spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid shes pa dang / rgyud mi 'gyur bas dgos pa dang / bya ba'i don thams cad mthar phyin pa dang / thos pa che bas sde snod mtha' dag gi don shes pa dang / blo gsal bas gzhan 'dod pa'i chos thams cad legs par ston nus pa'o/ /de skad du rgyan las/ tshul khrims dag cing mkhas ma sgrin/ /shes rab ldan zhing rgyud gcig la/ /thos nas legs par ston pa ni/ /rin chen zhes bya'i gang zag go /zhes so/ /yang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i skal ldan zhing / /rtag tu spyod pas rnam rgyan pa/ /'di ni rin chen gang zag ste/ /slob ma la bshad snod yin no/ /zhes so/ kye rdor khro bcu'i rigs bdag he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yin gsung / skyabs 'gro sogs kyi skabs rang la lha snang yod na legs gsung // ༈ //nang mchod byin rlabs skabs 'khor gsum rgyud gsum ro gcig bsres nas lta ba'i ngang nas bton na rung gsung / me 'bar ma sogs la dpe bltas byas chog gsung / brag rdzong ma'i khro bcu'i rigs bdag mi bskyod pa he ru ka phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyang pa'i brla la g.yon bskum pa'i gar stabs kyis pad nyi mi ro'i steng na bzhengs pa/ spyi bor rdo rje sngon pos mtshan pa zhig bsgom gsung // ༈ //'jigs byed bzlas pa sngon la ya ma ra dza nas 'don pa phyag len la yod kyang sngon la ya man+ta ka nas bgrang na smyo 'bogs mi 'byung ba sogs kyi dgos pa yod khong gis de bzhin mdzad pa yin gsung / dbang lha spyan drangs te gsol btab kyi tshe rigs lnga ma he'i zhal can du bsgyur/ sems dpa' brgyad kyang ma he'i zhal can g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon skyabs sbyin mdzad pa yin/

yum bzhi lha mo drug rnams rnam snang ji lta ba las dmigs bsal med/ skye mched kyi lha rnams khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa sha stag yin/ lus dkyil gyi gtso bo lnga la gdan yod kyang yum rnams la med/ sku'i dga' ba'i nyi dkyil de snying gar me long btags pa ltar mdun bstan bsgom/ bsnyen mtshams la 'dug tshe lus dkyil ma bsgom kyang chog rdzogs rim rdor bzlas tsam grub na legs/ bsnyen pa zhog nas lus dkyil dang rdzogs rim bsgom los dgos/ lar 'di'i rdzogs rim shin tu zab pa yin gsung / lus dkyil rang bzhin gyis gsal 'debs pa las lha bstim nas gsal 'debs pa lta bu phyag len mi mdzad gsung / bzlas dmigs skabs hūm̐ gi zhabs nas zhugs mdun bskor gyi rtse nas 'thon zhes pa klad kor yin nam gsung / ra khrid ldeb 10pa'i srib tu/ nu ma g.yon pa'i thad tsam phogs shing zer ba phyogs zer bar snang ngam ma dag rdzogs rim skabs rang nyid 'jigs byed na da'i bar bsdus nas rnam snang rigs kyi 'jigs byed dkar por bskyed de bsdu rim byed tshe sems dpa' sum brtsegs ma bsgom kyang rung / hūm̐ zhig thugs kar gsal btab nas rang nyid 'od du zhu thugs ka'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ de na da'i bar du bsdu/ gzhan rnams la'ang des 'gres sbyar chog gsung / shes rab ye shes kyi khrid skabs nang gi rigs lnga char gyi yum ro langs ma kho na yin gsungs/ brgyud 'debs kyi mdo khams dag snang zhes pa dag snang yin gsung / kha skong 'jug mtshams/ chos nyid ye shes zhabs la zhes pa'i mtshams yin/ ldeb 21pa'i srib tu/ mchog tu zhes pa rkang pa rdo rje zhes mchog tu shis pa red gsung / ldeb 22nyin myong ni 'char ngos la tshul 'di snang / du ba la sogs pa phyi nang rtags rnams ni dkar dmar ser sngo ljang mthing 'ong ba zhes pa tshig lhug re 'dug srib na de ni spyi'i tshul zhes pa don spyi zhes pa snang /

ldeb 24nyin/ sa brgyad pa'i bar bgrod ces pa sa bcu pa'i bar red gsung / ldeb 22gong du lag pa rdo rje khu tshur brla'i steng du gtsug ces pa brla rnyed gnyis su gtsug pa yin gsung // ༈ //mgon po'i gsang khrid skabs rnal 'byor pa rtogs ldan yin tshe phyi rol du gtor ma bshams/ gtor sngags brjod de lus dkyil mchod na des phyi rol gtor ma'i go chod/ kha zas rnal 'byor gyis sbyin sreg gi go chod pa dang 'dra zhes bla ma 'jam dpal bstan 'dzin gsungs pa yin gsung / 'bod rbad bsad gsum lhan du brjod pa legs gsung / bsrung bya rba ba'i skabs bla ma bsgom pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor du 'gro ba dang / pha ma gshin po bsgom pas de'i sgrib sbyong dang / gson po bsgom na skyabs 'jug tu 'gro bar gsung // ༈ //snang srid 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba bzhin du nges par rang sems yin pa'i go ba gting nas skyes tshe bla ma yang rang sems las logs na med pa'i phu thag chod/ gnam sa mgo 'jug log rung nyams nga ba dang bag tsha ba spu tsam med par de'i ngang la 'jog thub pa zhig dgos pa yin/ khyod kyis rang bab tu yod dus zla ba gsum du lam bsgom pa las/ da lta na tsha dang rkyen ngan byung dus rkyen dang bsres nas thun gcig bsgom pa nyid chod che ba yin/ de lta bu'i lta ba zhig rtogs tshe/ da lta rang re gnyis kyi lab byas pa'i tshe khong gi spyan lam na khyod snang ba'ang yin la stong pa'ang yin pa'i zer ma shes pa zhig 'dug khyod la de 'dra zhig i red gsung // ༈ //mgon po'i gsang khrid la bsdad tshe/ rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi rang gzugs rtsa gsum gyi nang du rlung sems rgyu 'grul byas pa'i dbang gis dregs pa rgyud gsum gyi snang ba shar ba ma gtogs phyi rol na med pa'i nges pa gting nas skyes te rang sems gdod ma'i mgon po bla ma nyid chos skyong gi rnam par shar ba ma gtogs dregs pa rang rgyud pa zhig phyi rol na med pa'i phu thag chod/

de 'dra zhig byung tshe gsang khrid kyi mtshams la bsdod na lam du 'gro/ de min pū tra ming sring sogs rang rgyud du bzung nas lus kyi rtsa gnad la bkod na smyo 'bog 'ong gsung / mgon po 'di sgrub pa la snying rje gal che/ snying rje che na mgon po snying nye/ snying rje lhod tshe mgon po cung zad 'gyangs 'gro ba zhig red gsung / rdor sems bdud rtsis nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyong ba rkang sor lag sor thams cad nas phyir 'thon pa'i dmigs pa byas kyang chog khong gis de 'dra mdzad pa yin gsung // ༈ //gang mtshan dran pas nang gi mun/ /sel byed lhag pa'i lha mchog dang / /dbyer med drin chen bla ma yis/ /byang chub bar du skyong bar mdzod/ /lam zab bla ma bsgom skabs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyang kye rdor gyi rnam pa sha stag mdun nas g.yas bskor du bzhugs par bsgom/ de'i rgyab kyi mdun phyogs su skal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong dang rigs lnga ste longs sprul gyi rnam pa can gyi sangs rgyas/ g.yas phyogs su yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang yi dam gnyis tha dad lta bur bshad kyang don du rgyal ba rigs lnga sangs rgyas dang / yi dam gnyis ka yin par shes dgos gsung // ༈ //rdor sems rgyud las/ spyi bor ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ /thod pa'i phreng ba de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pas thod skam gyi dbu rgyan yod par ltar gsung / ngor chen gyis gsang ba kun rgyan las yod par gsung / dbu rgyan yod tshe thod rlon gyi do shal kyang dgos pa 'dra gsung / gzhan phal cher gyis med rgyu mdzad 'dug gsung / rang tha mal pa'i spyi bor rdor sems bsgom pa rgya gzhung rnams su gsal yang / rje btsun rin po ches/ rang kye rdor du gsal ba'i spyi bor dam tshig rdo rje bskyed par gsungs pas rang lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bsgom kyang rung gsung // ༈ //brag rdzong ma'i sku gsung thugs mi 'gyur ba'i man ngag zab/

thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsgom pa de phyi nas phar bltas tshe me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar bsam pa yin/ bsrung bya sba ba'i rdo rje thugs dbus su yod gsung // ༈ //lam zab phyi ma'i bla ma'i sku lus la lus dkyil bsgom mi dgos/ bla ma'i gzugs phung rnam snang gi ngo bor yin pa sogs bsam pa las rnam pa bsgom mi dgos gsung // ༈ //rdor sems yab yum gnyis ka la rigs bdag yod/ de yang yab yum can yin/ khro bcu dbang lha sogs kyang des 'gre/ rigs bdag gi spyi bor rang rang gi phyag mtshan bsgom pa yin/ rigs drug pa'i rdo rje de nag po dang / don grub kyi ral gri dkar por gsung 'dug pa ma gtogs dmigs bsal med pa rnams la phyag mtshan gyi kha dog ji lta ba bzhin bsgom/ rigs bdag la pad zla dang pad nyi sogs gdan kyang yod/ phyag mtshan la med/ lus dkyil thams cad la gdan med pas de'i rigs bdag la gdan ma bsgoms kyang btub gsung // ༈ //gtor bsngo skabs/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs la khams gsum gyi sems can bstim rgyu de snang srid thams cad lhar shes pa'i ched yin/ gtor ma dbyibs legs pa dang / dngos po bzang ba gnyis rgya gzhung nas gsung tshul la dpag na dngos po bzang ba de gtso che gsung / lus dkyil gyi lha mo brgyad rang la bsdus zin pa'i rjes su rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis lha gang yin spyan drangs nas rang la bstim lha de'i nga rgyal gyis bzlas pa cung zad re byas na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ye shes dbyer med pa'i gnad kyis bdag bskyed kyi go chod rgyu mdzad pa ḍom+bhi pa'i man ngag yin par grag gsung / dbang 'di skabs rigs lnga'i phyag gi bum pa bcu drug bsgoms nas dbang bskur ba'i stangs ka mdzad/ he ru ka phyag gnyis pa zhig gi bum pa thogs nas dngos su spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba yin/ 'di'i rigs bdag rang 'dra yin pas rang la gdan ji yod rigs bdag la yod/

phreng ba byin rlabs skabs/ suṃ yig gi steng du oṃ hūm̐ bsgom pa yin/ phreng ba dgra bcom pa'i ngo bor mos pa las rnam pa bsgom mi dgos/ phreng thag sangs rgyas dang byang sems su mos pa las 'don rgyu ci'ang med/ oṃ pa de sogs 'gyur sngags kyi bla med kyi lha gzhan la bton na yang 'gyur sngags yin/ kha zas byin rlabs skabs/ rang gi snying gar lha dgu gsal btab ste/ dbang bskur bar bsam la gsungs kyang 'don rgyu ci yang med/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad gnyis lta bu thun mong du phyag rgya bca' dgos na nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bca' ba yin/ tshogs 'khor skabs/ ma da na mdun bskyed la phul dus de'i g.yon dang rang gis rol dus rang gi g.yon du 'jog dgos/ rigs bdag gi spyi bo'i phyag mtshan la gdan med/ rdo rje'i ra ba kha dog sngon po yin/ tog rdo rje phyed pa de'ang sngon po yin/ gau ri dzaḥzhes pa'i skabs srung 'khor srung 'khor la thim/ lha rnams nang du spyan drangs/ khro bcu'i rigs bdag he ru ka phyag gnyis pa yin/ rus phreng bzhi gshib/ se ral kha'i phreng ba gnyis gshib yin/ chos 'byung gi nang du pad nyi'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje/ de'i steng na gzhal yas khang yod/ tog ser po yin/ sgo glegs la 'khor lo sogs kyis mtshan pa yin/ ka ba'i mgo nas mar 'jug gi bar du 'khor lo sogs kyi phreng bas brgyan pa yin/ phyi dkyil gyi skye mched kyi lha rnams la pad zla ro gdan dang bcas pa yod gsung / snod bcud sbyong skabs bcud rnams lha dgu du mar bsam pa yin/ spyan 'dren skabs rten dang brten par bcas pa sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rnam pa can du mas bskor ba spyan 'dren pa yin/ rtsa zhal dang steng zhal gnyis ka'i dbu la 'khor lo yod kyang rgyan gcig tu rtsi ba yin/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi ma gtogs mtshams dang steng 'og la sbrul rgyan med gsung /

phyogs zhing gi zhon pa'i kha dog zhing skyong gi kha dog dang 'dra/ mngon byang bzhi pa'i kha dog zla nyi 'dres pa dkar la dmar mdangs can du bsgom gsung / 'byung bzhi 'dres pa kha dog sna tshogs/ thig le brgyad kyi mdog thig le dngos kyi mdog lta bu dkar la dmar mdangs can/ thugs rdo rje ma'i thugs kar sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi hūm̐ de bsgom/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phro pa de yin/ rtsib ma rdo rje gcig rjes la gcig mthud pa dang / rkang brgyad ka ba brgyad ka zhu yod pa dpung mgo'i phyogs yin/ sgal tshigs ri rab tu bsgom pa las don du ma dag pa'i sha khrag rus pa cung zad tsam yang bsgom pa min gsung / mgo la lcog bzhi bsgom pa ma gtogs ri rab mang ma la lcog med/ snying ga sa dkyil/ thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs go sa gcig kyang gcig gis gcig mi sgrib pa yin/ pags pa gur bla bre zhes pa la ngos 'dzin tha dad med kyang pags pa la gzugs brnyan shar ba'i tshul gyis rdo rje phra mo gyen la 'greng ba dang 'phred la nyal ba bar mtshams med par bsam pa yin/ zla ba'i lha nyi ma'i lha zer ba de nyi zla dngos yin/ rkang mthil rlung gi 'og tu gnod mdzes bsgom pa yin/ lus dkyil thams cad mi bskyod par bskyed de dbang len na de thams cad la skye mched byin rlabs dgos/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ gsal btab tshe/ sems 'dzin skabs dmigs bsal ma gtogs gzhan lha brgya lnga bcu sogs kyi thugs kar sa bon gsal mi dgos btang snyoms su 'jog gsung / dbang rdzas kyi lha la gtso bo mi bskyod pa rang gis dbang bskur ba yin/ las rdor phye mi dgos/ bum chus dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur dus dbang lha rnams bsgyur mi dgos/ rigs lnga rnams rgyun du g.yas brgyad rdo rje g.yon brgyad dril bu sogs 'dzin pa bsgom/ dmigs bsal bum pa'i dbang gi tshe phyag thams cad kyis bum pa 'dzin pa sogs yin/

swa bhā wa skabs bla mas las bum 'thor ba'i tshul mdzad/ lha rnams steng gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte ba na mi bskyod pa/ 'dab brgyad la rigs bzhi/ yum bzhi bstod pa/ gsol gdab kyi tshe pad 'dab kyi steng du nyi gdan rkyang pa ro'i steng du he ru ka bsgom gsung / mjug gi lha dgu'i rigs bdag la pad nyi bdud bzhi bsgom kyang chog go gsung / gsang dbang gi ji ltar sogs bla ma mi bskyod pas gsung bar bsam pa yin/ pad+ma 'khor lo sogs kyis yu ba byas pa'i dril bu la lha'i zhal yod gsung // ༈ //chos rje'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs rang tha mal du bsgom pa yin/ rang la lha'i snang ba rgyun du yod na lhar bsgom kyang rung / gnas gsum 'bru gsum de zhal zas la dkar rgyan btags pa ltar dbu ma dang sgrel bar bsam/ thos pa rgya mtsho sogs sgrub pa'i mchod pa mchod yon sogs kyi rnam pa bsgom mi dgos// ༈ //rigs lnga la zhal sbyor gyi yum yod kyang mtshams kyi lha mo rnams rang sor 'jog gtsug tor 'khor sgyur gyi gdan pad nyi de chos 'byung gi 'og tu yod rgyu byas kyang chog/ ༈ //sa 'jam sbag sgrub kyi mgor stong nyid bsgom skabs rang gzhan thams cad bde stong nyid du bsgom nas de nas gsal 'debs pa yin// ༈ //sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rdo rje'i ra ba bsgom pa yin gsung / phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yab kyi zhal du zhugs zhes pa la gdan yod med ji ltar byas kyang chog lus dkyil gyi rigs bdag sngon 'gro'i rdor sems lta bu yin/ pho brang lnga gtso bo sogs dmigs bsal med pa rnams la me phung 'bar ba ma bsgom kyang chog sgal tshigs ri rab tu bsgom pa'i shar phyogs nang ngos yin/ yab kyi gsang rdor ra lnga sems dpa' lnga zhes pa ye shes lnga la go rung // ༈ //zhi drag sbyong ba byed dus/ byin rlabs zur du med par sngags des gtor ma rgya chen por brlabs pa dang /

de la bsngo ba gnyis ka 'grub pa yin/ cha gsum gyi bgegs gtor la'ang des 'gre/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab na bgegs dman pa rnams kyis thob dka' bar gsung zhes gsung // ༈ //gsung rdo rje ma mgrin pa'i 'od dpag med dang mdun gyi lha mo'i bar du bsgom/ thugs rdo rje ma'i thugs kar bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ yul gyi lha mo chos mkha' spyod ma bcas zhal sbyor du mi bskyod pa'i mdun lha mo'i bar du bsgom gsung / snod bcud sbyang ba dang bsdu rim skabs/ rten brten pa gnyis las logs na snod bcud zhig yod skad gsung pa ni ye shes tshogs bsags kyis sbyangs kyang 'dir slar yang sbyong ba yin pas mi 'gal gsung / 'khor lo bzhi rdzogs skabs snying kha'i hūm̐ dang / mgrin pa'i oṃ gnyis gnas de gnyis su rtsa dbu ma rang 'khyogs po yi ge'i rnam pa can du bsgom pa ma gtogs dbu ma'i nang du bsgom na de ha cang phra bas bsgom bde mo zhig mi 'ong gsung / dang po nas rlung bzung nas rtsa yig yongs rdzogs gsal 'debs pa'i lugs zhig dang / 'bar 'dzag lte ba'i gong du slebs tshe rlung 'dzin pa'i lugs gnyis ka snang gsung // ༈ //bir srung skabs ro ma'i mes pho brang lnga'i yig 'bru rnams gsal 'debs pa las khams snyigs ma bsreg mi dgos/ ro ma'i me dbu ma'i nang du ma song yang / de'i 'od kyis yig 'bru gsal 'debs pa yin/ srung ba phyi ma la rlung gcig bzung nas mas 'gro gcig dang yas 'gro gnyis kyis chog phyag rgya la lar gung mo dang / la lar mdzub mo zer ba de snga ma gong ma dang phyi ma 'phags pa'i bzhed pa yin// ༈ //lam zab nang ma'i rdo rje 'chang dang bdag med ma gnyis ka bsgom rgyu byas na/ rnam pa kye rdor du bsgom pa yin/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan brjod kyang chog khro bo'i khro gnyer smin ma'i bar spyan dbus ma'i 'og na yod/

dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul sogs brjod mi dgos/ ro ma'i me de snying gar slebs pas/ de'i 'od kyis yig 'bru rtsa 'khor rnams gsal 'debs pa las/ dbu ma'i nang du me lce ma song yang chog rtsa 'khor lnga'i lte ba'i yig 'bru rnams gsal gdab dgos pas dbu ma yang gsang gnas kyi bar du zug yod/ rkyang pa las byang sems 'bab pa'i tshe yang / de'i 'od zla zer gyi mdog lta bu des thams cad gsal 'debs pa yin// ༈ //lam zab nang ma la 'jug tu rlung gcig las ma bzung kyang mang thos kyi bzhed pa yin zhing / bla mas kyang gnang ngo / /oṃ zhes pas stong / āḥthod pa/ hūm̐ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ hos dbyer med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsam/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyi tshe la bdud rtsi de/ ha ho hrī gsum gyi tshe kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa zhig dmigs na chog gsung // ༈ //bir srung phyi nang / lam zab phyi nang gi skyabs yul lam dus ltar byas chog bir srung nang ma'i skabs lte 'og gi me/ de nas yar ro ma'i nang du zhugs pa ma gtogs gsang gnas su ma song yang / me'i 'od des yig 'bru gsal 'debs pa yin gsung // ༈ //gnas gsum yi ge gsum las 'od sna tshogs/ /'bru gsum gzugs byung zhes pa de dkar dmar mthing gsum yin/ sna tshogs min gsung // ༈ //bir srung pho brang lnga'i yi ge gsang lte mgo gyen bstan/ snying ga thur bstan/ mgrin pa gyen/ spyi bor thur/ oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ// ༈ //chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang steng ma'i rtse mdun bstan 'og ma rgyab bstan/ skyabs yul dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi gdan pad+ma'i kha dog phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser/ /dbang ldan sngo la bden bral ljang / /lte ba ljang la ge sar ser/ /rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gnyis ka la rang 'dra'i rigs bdag yod/ mchod yon ma dkar/ me tog ma dkar/ bdug spos ma dud kha/ mar me ma dmar skya/

dri chab ma ljang / zhal zas ma dmar/ sgra ma sngon mo/ bdud rtsi myong ba'i tshe/ mtheb srin gyis rtse rang la bstan pa'i chos 'byung gcig g.yon bskor du bris te/ bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma dbus su bam̐ yig gi rnam par gnas pa de blang nas lce thog tu bzhag de zhu nas snying ga'i bam̐ yig sogs 'dra/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi gnas khang chos 'byung de mkhyen brtse'i gsung rgyun la nyis brtsegs yin gsung / rang gi mgo bla ma'i sku pang la 'jog pa'am pad zla la 'jog pa yin/ ku sa li'i tshogs gsag gi skabs rang sems rnal 'byor ma rgyan med gri gug can yin/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor tshe rang pad nyi drod bcas kyi steng du nyal bar bsam pas gnyid mi 'thug pa'i dgos pa yod/ 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo rnams bla ma'i dbang po lnga la thim par bsgoms pas yul lnga dbang du 'du ba'i rten 'brel/ mchod lha rnams rang gi thugs kar thim pas rang gi rlung sems dbu mar 'char ba'i rten 'brel/ rgyal srid sna bdun 'jog pa chos kyi rgyal srid brtan pa'i rten 'brel/ yul yul can gyi lha rnams yongs grags dang mthun/ tho brtsegs su bsgom pa byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun bar ma chad pa'i dgos pa yod/ khrom tshogs su bsgom pa mnga' thang rgyas pa/ kun 'dus nor bu'i lugs byin rlabs myur 'jug gi dgos pa yod/ ku sa li'i tshogs gsag skabs/ lha mo thod pa che chung gnyis re thogs pa/ chung bas bcus che ba'i nang du blugs/ de nas mchod yul gyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol bar bsam/ rgya che ba'i sbyang gzhi gnas nyer bzhi/ yul so gnyis kyi rtsa yig rnams yin la/ zab pa'i sbyang gzhi dbu ma mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi sems nyid spros bral/ dpa' bo rdo rje chos/ sangs rgyas rdo rje chos gnyis ka dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ rus rgyan la rin po ches phra btab pa la de skad gsung / rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs bdag gi dbu steng gi rdo rje phyed pa yin gsung /

rang rje btsun ma'i gdan pad+ma dmar/ thod pa skam po sum brtsegs/ rigs bdag gi rnam snang rdor dril bsnol nas 'dzin par gsung / chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang du lha bsgom pa'i grwa bzhir dga' 'khyil bsgoms kyang chog nang lus dkyil gyi lha rnams la'ang rigs bdag rang chas yod rgyu byams pa kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad 'dug sngags gnyis bzlog byas tshe swā oṃ gyi logs su slebs par 'dug pas ha zhes pa yi ge ma dag gsung / chos 'byung gis gzhal yas khang gi go chod gsung / bsam mi khyab kyi bsdu rim skabs snod 'od dmar po'i rnam par bsdu zhes gsung sna sgo nas nyi rdul bzhin spros/ de dag gis chos bshad rnal 'byor ma'i sar bkod/ yang sprul 'gro ba dang bcas pa sngags skyes lhan skyes zhing skyes te phyi'i rnal 'byor ma rnams bsdus/ lte ba'i nang gi rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de gsang ba'i rnal 'byor mar bsdu ba yin gsung / nang gi rnal 'byor ma de la rgyan yod/ dbu ma'i yar rtse kha bye yod/ lus dkyil zla ba'i steng du 'jigs dus kyi gdan re thams cad la yod/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i mtha' bskor du mgron thabs kyi sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang po yod gsung / yab dang thun mong gi 'pho ba'i bde mchog sku mdog sngon po/ spyi bo nas bla ma bde mchog bar la sbrel byed rtsa med gsung / bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas pas bsdus pa'i go chod gsung / bsam mi khyab nang mas phyi ma'i go chod/ bdag bskyed tshig bcad ma la sum+bha ni med pa 'dra/ yid kyi dri ma kun brtags lhan skyes ngag gi dri ma rang bzhin brgyad cu'i zhon pa'i rlung / lus tha mal snang zhen// ༈ //lam zab nang ma'i bla ma tho brtsegs kyi tshig bsdus chog gsung / lam zab nang ma'i tshig zin la rtsa yang yod dam snyam pa zhig 'dug rung / rtsa bsgom mi dgos gsung //

༈ //rtsa dbu ma chen po'i khrid kyi skabs gdong rkang khrid la rlung re bsal tshod la rlung re 'dzin dgos pa 'dra/ sngon 'gro rtsa lam sbyang ba'i tshe thun chung re la bsngo ba mdor bsdus re ji ltar byas kyang dgos/ rlung bzung nas rkang mthil gyi rlung gsos sogs bsgom/ rngub chung gsum sogs kyi skabs bar rlung 'dzin pa 'dra/ yum gyi rtsa dbu ma tsaṇ+ḍa li zhes pa gsang lam nang gi des chog 'od kyi gtum mo dang / tha mal gyi gtum mo'i sgra bshad ma gzigs gsung / srod char rang rang gi dmigs pa sogs thun stod la zer ba red gsung / sngon 'gro rtsa lam sbyong ba yun ring bsgom nas/ dngos gzhi bdag byin rlabs bsgom dus snga ma ma bsgom kyang rung / khar hriṃ maṃ sogs lce steng du zla ba gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du bsgom/ yi ge gnyis mgo gre phug tu lta ba bsgom na bde bar gsung / bsam gyis mi khyab thun min gyi sprul pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams bsdus nas sna sgo'i rnal 'byor ma rkyang ma'i lam brgyud lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de nas rlung 'dzin pa yin gsung / spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu sogs mkhyen brtses zla ba gdan thabs su bsgom par gsung / zla ba rgyab yol gyi tshul du bsgom na bde bas spyi gtsug gi zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gnyis mgo ltag par phyogs pa'i tshul gyis bsgom na rung gsung // ༈ //bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhi bdag gtor ma yan chad dang po lhan cig tu byin gyis brlab nas/ de nas sger du byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba yin gsung / kun brtags kyi bdag 'gog pa'i rigs pa rnams lhan skyes kyi la sbyor shes pa dang / dngos smra ba'i grub mtha' 'gog byed rnams chos kyi bdag 'gog pa la sbyor shes dgos gsung / gang la yang rten 'brel gnad du tshe/ ngag dbang bshad sgrub kyi rlung ras dmar po yin/ nyi dga'i dkar po yin/ phyi ma de khong gi thugs la ma 'ben/

phyis nyi dga' tshang la grang ba'i nad gzhi 'byung ba'i rkyen de las byung gsung / thun mtshams su bla ma'i mos gus dang lta ba'i dran 'dzin gtso/ tshe sgrub la bsgom thub na grub rgyal lugs kyi bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug de las zab pa med/ sngags 'don rgyu la sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs de zab gsung / bir srung de khyod la gnad che bar 'dug pas rem gsung / bir srung la brag rdzong ma'i de zab nges pa yin gsung // ༈ //mkha' spyod ma'i dpe gsum gyi don gcig gtan la 'bebs gsungs pa 'di dang / bir srung nang ma 'di gnyis gnad gcig pas rlung sems dbu mar sdud pa la 'di las zab pa med gsung // ༈ //lam zab nang ma'i kyai rdo rje bdag med ma la thim zhes pa de mi dag 'di gnyis thabs shes rab kyi cha tsam yin pas kyai rdo rje yab yum rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa la thim zhes brjod na legs gsung // ༈ //rlung ro bsal tshe lhag ma lus na nad gzhi red 'gro bas lhag ma med par 'bud/ nang du rngub tshe sgra bcas red na grang ba'i nad gzhi bskyed 'ong bas sgra med du rngub dgos/ rlung mi thub na dal bus gtong dgos gsung / pod dmar nang gi ngor chen gyi bir srung de la ltos dang gnad yod gsung / 'chi kha 'du shes bcu gcig bstan pa'i mdo ltar byas na legs/ tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo dang / srid pa 'pho sogs dum pa zhig red gsung / rlung rkyang pa bzung bas drod skye dka'/ me dmigs zhig dang 'dres na dga'/ nang ma'i skabs/ ro ma nas me 'bar bas khams snyigs ma rnams bsreg haṃ la phog de las khams dkar po dngul chu'i mdog ltar bab 'khor lo rnams gsos/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung sems dbu mar zhugs par bsgom/ de'ang rlung 'dzin pa'i tshe ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung rngub pa'i rkyen gyis ded de dbu mar zhugs par bsgom na snang ba sems yin pa'i gnad kyis 'du 'ong gsung /

'chi kha'i dam tshig gso ba la bdag 'jug dang lam dus gnyis gtso/ de bzhin du sgo gsum gyi dam tshig gso ba'i dmigs pa legs po zhig 'dzin shes nas bzung bla ma'i rnal 'byor kho nas dam tshig gso thub/ bla ma rang la bstim ste dbang bzhi dus gcig la len pa'i dmigs pa byas na'ang chog pa 'dra gsung // ༈ //sngar byas sdig pa thams cad da lta'i rig pa skad cig ma'i rnam 'phrul du shes/ de'ang bla ma dang ngo bo dbyer med du shes nas lta thog tu 'jog pa gnad che zhes gsung / khyod kyis dang por lta ba 'di la nan tan gyis/ de nas yig brgya 'bum ther gcig 'don bsgom bsgrags nas rem/ phyin chad dam tshig la gces spras dang bcas gsang khrid bsgom/ de nas rang lus phru ma phus btab pa ltar stong sang nge yod pa/ lag mdzub kyi nang tshun chod stong par ma zad snyan shog shin tu srab pa'i nang yang stong sang nge ba/ nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga yang mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu/ pū tra ming sring yang lha bcu gnyis ma'i lha ngo bstan pa ltar/ mgon po'i ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul du blta ba las/ dregs pa rang rgyud par nam yang mi 'dzin par shin tu gal che/ bud med mi bcu gnyis bsad pa zhig gis byang sems zla rgyal gyi drung du smyung gnas rnam dag lnga/ cha le cho le lnga gcig gdan thog gcig byas pas/ phyi ma rgya gar gyi bram ze'i bur skyes/ de nas bde ba can du song bar gsungs pa ltar sdig pa 'dags pa la tshegs med gsung / sngon gyi sdig pa dang da lta'i sems gnyis gcig tha dad dpyad na/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i sa smyug la dpyad pa'i skabs ltar shes par byos gsung / phyi rol gyi dregs pa rgyud gsum rnams/ nang rtsa thig rlung gi rten 'brel las byung bar shes/ de sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi rol par shes sems nyid brjod bral blo 'das kyi ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa lta ba/ nyams len de bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu shes pa bsgom pa/

rjes snang thams cad la nyams len de'i rtsis zin pa spyod pa yin gsung / rlung gtong dus rngub nas gtong ba de mi rung gsung / bzlog pa'i skabs ro ma rnams zhabs 'og gi mgon pa'i zhal du btab sha khrag gi gtor mas mnyes/ lte ba'i rlung me'i stobs kyis bsreg zhu sbyangs te/ dwang ma rnams sku stod du song / snyigs ma sku smad du lus pa nam mkha' la dengs/ dwangs ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pas sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang / mthu stobs nus pa 'phel zhing / bde chen gyi ye shes kyis mnyes nas 'gro ba myong bas grub/ bkrag mdang gzi byin mchog tu gyur par bsam/ sprul pa spro ba dang yang sprul spro ba 'di dmag 'ong ba sogs la byas na pha rol po mthu stobs nyams nas 'gro ba myong bas grub/ 'khor lo ser chung dang / drag po sngags rgod gnyis rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skye ba la gnad che gsung / drag po sngags rgod kyis lus la drod skye gsung / khyod gsang khrid la sdod pa la dang po phyi khrid kyi bsnyen pa mahā ka la 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi can zhig phud/ de nas yig brgya 'bum phrag gcig gnad du 'gro nges rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga gsal btab nas bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong gi dmigs pa byas na dngos gzhi'i rdzogs rim lam du 'gro ba la phan/ de'i dus su dam tshig la srung sdom dang / sems can la snying rje/ bla ma la mos gus rnams gal che/ rtsub nyams chen po'ang 'byung nye che yang de la 'jigs skrag mi byed par gang shar rang sems kyi cho 'phrul/ de'ang blo 'das brjod bral gyi ngang la bzhag nas/ lta ba'i ngang las ma g.yos par gnam sa mgo mjug log yong yang nyams nga bag tsha 'chor mi nyan/ chos skyong 'grub pa'i lnga ltas kyang rtsub nyams 'ong gsung / lta ba la yid ches gting nas skyes/ nang rtsa 'khor thams cad dwang gsal 'ja' tshon 'dra ba de'i nang khams dkar dmar gyis gang ba/

de'ang gdos bcas ma yin pa gsal zhing thogs pa med pa rtsa gnas la bkod pa'i lha rnams kyang nag po chen po'i ye shes kyi rnam rol/ de yang rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi rang mdangs/ chos nyid brjod pa'i mtha' mtha' dag dang bral bar shes nas de'i steng la mnyam par 'jog thub dgos/ 'di'i bogs 'don gegs sel thams cad la bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di zab gsung / kun spyod rtsang na/ 'chol bar spyod na spu gri rum bcug 'dra/ gsung pa lta bu yin/ khyod la las 'phro yod par 'dug pas/ de sad pa la 'di gnad du che/ dkor gdul bya byed pa bas/ nor sgrub 'di bzang / de la byang sems dang dam tshig gnyis med na mi 'grub/ khong gis bden stobs brjod pa'i tshe de 'dra'i snang ba dang / rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad rang sems skad cig ma'i cho 'phrul/ de yang spros bral gyi lta ba'i ngang la bzhag pas g.yo 'gul med par khrigs se 'grigs pa zhig 'ong gin 'dug gsung / rje sa chen gyis/ zhing dang dngos po bsam pa gsum/ /gcig tu dril la gsol ba thob/ /ces gsungs pa'i gnad 'di 'dra la go ba yin no gsung / khyod kyis bla ma la phyag phyi sgrub lugs bla ma bsten lugs legs pas khyod tshe 'jug la bar chad kyi dbang du mi 'gro snyam gsung / khyod la gsang sgrub kyi rnal 'byor de snga smras pa rnams brjed mi nyan/ tshe rabs sngon ma nas lha 'di la las 'brel yod par 'dug pas rem dgos de yang lta ba'i ngang nas/ snang ba 'dra mi 'dra la skrag sngangs gtan nas mi bya'am/ cung zad skyes kyang rtogs pa'i bogs 'don du gyur nas/ phyi'i snang ba rnams rtsa khams kyi rten 'brel/ de gsal stong zung 'jug gi rol pa/ de rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su ngo shes/ de'i ngang la g.yo 'gul med par sdod tshugs pa zhig ci nas rem gsung / khong gi da ltar mnyam par bzhag ma thag rig pa'i ye shes ljen la bud nas/
