de'i ngang la rgyun du gnas pa zhig red gsung / bal po bha ro'i phyag chad pa 'jigs byed kyi zhal gzigs nas khong la thim pa'i snang ba shar nas phyag zhabs gsar du skyes pa dang / dge slong ma dpal mo'i phyag chad pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal gzigs nas sor chud pa dang / mchog sred kyis sbyin sreg gi me'i nang nas thugs rje chen po'i zhal gzigs pa la/ grub pa chen po brgyad kyi sgo nas 'gro don 'byung ba'i dngos grub zhus pa gnang ba ltar/ sngar lha'i zhal mthong ba la dngos grub chen po thob pa'i lo rgyus yod/ deng sang ni de 'dra ma red gsung / khyod kyis snang gsum la rem gsung pa de/ tshe 'dir zhen pa chod gsungs pa yin nam snyam pa dang / mi las ras chung pa'i nga rgyal bcag tshul gsung pa de nga rgyal chung dgos gsung pa yin no snyam pa shar/ dang po bla ma dkon mchog la phyag mchod gsal gdab mos gus drag po bsgom/ de nas zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum sogs gsung pa ltar de thams cad rang sems kyi cho 'phrul du shes nas snang sems bsres/ de nas dbyings rig bsres nas 'jog pa rim gyis byed pa las dang po nyid nas chab gcig la mi 'ong gsung / gzhung rtsa ba rnams blo la e lon bltos/ thos bsam sgom gsum dkrugs mar gyis la rem gsung / khyod la nag po chen po'i zhal gzigs 'ong na dngos grub zhu ba chung mi rung gsung / klu chen brgyad bran du 'khor ba zhig zhu na'ang don che gsung / rdor sems skabs rtsa 'khor rnams gsal btab dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa byed dgos/ 'jor ber gser ma gar gos re ber red gsung / sag ra'i lham 'ja' ris ma red/ khyod kyis gsang khrid bsgom dus bde ba sgrub pa'i dmigs pa bsgom zhing / 'bar 'dzag skra shad 'dzings pa lta bu la sems gtad nas skabs su mahā ka la bzla/ skabs su bsgom na lus la bde drod skyes/ des khams snyigs ma zad dwangs ma 'phel/

des lus zag med 'ja' lus dang sems rtog med chos sku 'grub pa yin gsung / bdag bskyed rgyas pa 'don long ma byung na skad cig gis rang lhar bskyed/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga gsal btab nas rdzogs rim bsgom na chog ste/ ba ri bi re tshar gcig las dmigs pa gsal ba de 'dra bzang gsung // ༈ //lags rin po che/ don grub la sprul sku tshang sku khams bde min ci 'dra dris pas/ phyag lag skrang pas snyung ba dang / shangs tshal yang cung zad bab tshul zer bas yid skyo ngal gyis gdung bar gyur/ lar khyed lta bu'i gang zag bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus can rnams kyis chos rje sa paṇa gyis gu shrī jo 'bum la gnang ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi don ltar lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor dkyus bzhin gsal btab nas ku sā li'i tshogs gsog dmigs pa shin tu gsal ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i gdengs dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bsgom na lus nad thams cad lhag med du zhi 'gro bar gsung / de'ang 'khor 'das gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems gcig nyid de dang der shar ba'i gnad la nges shes gting nas rnyed pa rnams kyis lus dngos su btang ba dang / dmigs pas btang ba gnyis la khyad par cung zad kyang med pa chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du rig pa thub dbang shākya'i rgyal po'i gsung rab du ma nas gsal ba thugs la mnga' ba ltar lags/ de'i phyir nang gi tshogs mchod tshar brgya phrag gcig bsags na nad gdon phra rags thams cad lhag med du zhi 'gro/ de la gnad 'di bzhin shes dgos te/ bla ma la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor thag chod cing / yid gnyis dang the tshom gtan nas med pa'i mos gus kyi gdung ba drag po dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba dang gcig dngos gzhi'i dmigs rnam shin tu gsal bar bsgom pa dang gnyis/ de la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i rgyas thebs pa dang gsum 'dzom na phan yon gong bzhin 'byung ba la the tshom med/

de'ang bdud rtsi sbyin pa'i skabs su bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyan thos rang rgyal chos srung nor lha rigs drug lhar gsal ba bcas la phul tshar rjes/ rang la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren lan chags kyi mgron dang bcas pa rnams mtha' bskor du 'khod pa la bdud rtsi byin pas gnod sems gdug rtsub rnams zhi/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis rgyud la skyes nas sangs rgyas par bsam pa sogs dkyus bzhin bya'o/ /nad gdon gyis gtan mi brdzi ba'i gdeng thob nas/ nyid kyi lhag pa'i lha mo'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson par mdzad na shes rab kyi rtsa sgo thams cad bye nas/ paṇa chen mi pham bstod par/ rig stong 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i byin rlabs las/ /dgongs pa'i klong du spobs pa'i gter brgyad grol/ /lung rtogs chos mdzod rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag che/ /a dzi ta bi dza ya la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa lta bu'i yon tan mngon du mdzad nas/ rnam dag rig pas log smra tshar gcod cing / /gzhung brgya 'chad pas skal ldan rjes su 'dzin/ /bsdeb legs rtsom pas mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed/ /smra ba kun gyi gtsug rgyan la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa lta bu'i mkhas pa'i bya bas bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa mkhyen mkhyen// ༈ //bla ma blo gros phun tshogs de ni/ rje sa paṇa gyis/ lta ba spros bral rnam dag shugs 'chang lus/ /yengs med bsgom pa rnam dag yan lag ldan/ /spyod pa rnam dag g.yu yi ral pa can/ /seṅge gangs la 'gyings ba'i bsgom chen yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i yon tan dang ldan 'dug deng sang bsgom chen phal cher la/ gzhan ngo srung ba'i ched du yag po red bzang po los yin zer ba tsam ma gtogs snying nas mgu ba gcig kyang ma byung / rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma ri'i mtshan can gang la dang 'dod kyi dad pa snying nas skyes so// ༈ //bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun rig dbang gi go don la/

'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'i ngang nas bla med kyi rigs pa'i dbang lnga sogs kyi go ba sbyar nas rang gis len pa dang gzhan la dbang bskur e rung lags/ 'di bzhin chog ces gsung / dkyil 'khor la bum pa 'bul e dgos/ ma ma rin chen sogs la dpyad/ a mes zhabs kyis bdag med sgrub thabs rnam bshad na bum pa phul na cho ga rgyas pa'i yan lag yin/ ma phul kyang chad skyon med ces gsung 'dug gsung // ༈ //smin byed kyi rgyu dbang dang lam dag thob nas yang rgyu dbang zhu tshe/ lus dkyil gyis len pa'i dmigs pa byed dgos sam/ 'di yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin byed pa yin gsung / bdag med gnyis lhan cig la bsgom rgyu de legs gsung / mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la thim zhes pa'i rjes su snying ga'i 'od zer gyi bla ma he ru ka mgon po lha dgu'i rnam par spyan drangs rang la bstim nas lus dkyil gsal 'debs pa yin/ khong gi bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom tshe da ltar dmyal bar gnas dgos pa byung yang sems can gzhan bde na nges par bzod snyam pa'i lhag bsam 'byung bar 'dug gsung / zhabs non bdud bzhi lag gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba yin/ snying gar sbyar na mi bde gsung / drag po nag po khro gnyer can de mi 'thad/ lha mo brgyad kyi gdan rnams la dar dang rin po che'i rgyan yod/ spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas mgo g.yon du bstan yod/ gzhal yas khang gi rta bab/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rnam bshad snying po don gsal du man ngag rnam bshad du drangs pa'i rje btsun gyi lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi lugs de ngor chen gyi dgongs pa dang 'grigs kyi kun mkhyen gsung dang mi 'byor zhes gsung yod pas zla nyi zer dang man ngag rnam bshad kyi rta bab mi 'grigs gsung // ༈ //rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg skabs rigs drug gi sa bon bstim nas gnas sbyong gi dmigs pa rung gsung //

༈ //'jam dbyangs sbags sgrub la sdod na dran pa la phan gsung // ༈ //mgon po'i gsang sgrub 'di la spyod lam shin tu dam dgos/ mi gzhan gyis mthong song na bar chad 'byung bas chu len sogs la 'gro mi rung / dam tshig nyams chag byung ba la 'khu ldog 'byung bas yig brgya la nan tan gyis/ bdag 'jug dang lam dus bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams kyis dam tshig gsos/ da khyed kyis mdor bsdu ba'i dus la thug 'dug pas mgon po'i gsang khrid kyi nyams len 'di la rem/ 'di la brten nas khyed kyis dngos grub chen po zhig thob 'ong snyam gsung rmi lam dang sgyu lus la sbyong / rmi lam gyis sems dang / sgyu lus kyis lus la bden 'dzin 'jig pa red gsung / bla na med pa'i skyabs 'gro'i ngos 'dzin gong zhus ltar red 'dug gsung // ༈ //sngon 'gro tshogs bsag skabs/ rang kye rdor du gsal ba sogs sbyong gzhi sbyong byed legs par ngo 'phrod na nyag mgon lta bu'i sdig rgan yin kyang tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas byung ba yin te gser 'gyur gyi rtsi lta bu'i gdams ngag ces pa'i gnad yin gsung / kye rdor dkyil thang kha shar la bstan/ slob dpon rang nyid gang bder bsdod nas dkyil 'khor la kha phyogs par mos pas chog mkha' spyod ma la dkyil 'khor lhor bstan dgos/ slob dpon gang bder 'khod/ sa gar gyi g.yas brkyang sogs lta bas zin pas phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi gnad shes pa mtshon bya mtshon byed sbyar shes dgos gsung / dbu ma la sbyar na chos thams cad bden med du shes/ de'ang rang sems gcig nyid rkyen bzang ngan gyis de dang der snang ba ma gtogs don la grub pa med cing / sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar shes na chos skyong thams cad la snying chu dus gcig la bsre thub pa yin pas 'khu ldog mi 'byung zhing myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no gsung /

skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ skyabs su 'gro ba po/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul rnams rang sems kyi cho 'phrul du thag rbad kyis bcad de/ dang por snang sems bsres/ de nas gnyis 'dzin re dogs kyis ma bslad par bcas bcos med par bzhag nas dbyings rig bsres te bsgom nus na/ gsal stong zung 'jug ljen lhang gis 'char ba de lta ba/ lta ba de'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin skyabs 'gro'i snang cha rnams ma 'gag par nyams su len pa bsgom pa nyams len de nyid rjes thob kyi snang ba dang bsres nas lam du khyer ba spyod pa yin no/ /lta ba shes rab/ bsgom pa thabs/ lta bsgom zung du chud na thabs shes zung 'jug tu 'gyur ba yin/ de ji ma ji lta 'phags pa ma thob bar mi 'ong yang / mos pa yid byed kyi tshul du da lta nas bsgom dgos/ nyams len de la snang gsum rgyud gsum sogs thams cad tshang zhing / lam 'bras kyi mtshan gyi rnam pa bcu gcig po thams cad tshang dgos/ de yang gzhan rnams go sla/ bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel/ ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel tshul/ phyi'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po yang nang rdo rje'i lus kyi rten 'brel las byung bar shes shing de'ang rang sems su ngo 'phrod/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug sku gsum mam dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor thag chod tshe phyi nang gi rten 'brel gyi dbang gis bdud rigs chos skyong du zhal bsgyur/ chos skyong sprul skur gnas 'gyur nas bar chad ngo shes pas bdud kyi gegs sel/ bying rgod kyi rtog pa ye shes su ngo 'phrod pas ting nge 'dzin ngo shes pas bsam gtan gyi gegs sel bya ba yin/ sngon gdong bsre bla ma chos dbyings zer ba gsang khrid la bsdad/ dang po gnyid yal/ de nas smyo 'bog byung ba yin/ des na bla ma'i mos gus dang lta ba gnad du che/ rtsub nyams la skyon du 'dzin mi rung / tshar chen gyis zhal gyi dbang gsan tshe kha'u brag rdzong gi ri nyil nas mnan byung ba'i nyams shar bas re zhig dran med la brgyal song yang don la chos skyong 'go ba'i rtags yin/

snang phyogs stong phyogs gnyis sgro bkur gyis bsdus/ rang byung dang po gsum bying rgod kyis bsdus/ dga' ba dang po gsum bde stong gi phyogs su lhung / bzhi ba'i lhan skyes skyon med yin/ gsum pa'i lhan skyes rgya chung / yum gyi rkang brgyad/ rje'i bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa sbas don kun gsal na yod// ༈ //mgon po'i bsnyen pa mtshams la sdod pa'i thog mar mgon po lha dgu rang sems kyi cho 'phrul/ de'ang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lngar rlung sems rgyu 'grul gyi dbang gis/ gdugs nam mkhar 'phyar ba'i grib ma sa la 'bab pa bzhin/ phyi rol rgyud gsum gyi snang ba shar bar thag bcad nas rang sems ma bcos pa'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog nus na sems nyid gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngo bo ljen lhang gis gsal yong bas/ de lta bu'i lta ba la yid ches bcos ma ma yin pa zhig ma skyes na/ 'khu ldog 'byung zhing gnad shes na chos skyong dang snying chu bsre ba zhes bya ba mna' 'jog pa'i don yin pas 'khu ldog gtan nas mi 'byung gsung // ༈ //bla ma gzhan dga'i zhal nas/ bla ma rnams sprul gzhi'i klong na tha dad med ces pa lhun grub kyi snang cha'i klong na tha dad med ces pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams chos sku'i klong na tha dad med ces pa ka dag dbyings kyi ngos la khyad med zer ba red gsung // ༈ //lha snang med kyang rang ngo shes pa'i lta ba dang ma bral bar lam dus sogs nyams su blang na de las lhag pa ci yod gsung / bsgrub pa'i lhong phyi'i mi kha dgra gyod sogs dang / nang nyon mongs dug lnga/ gsang ba'i bar chad re dogs the tshom dang bcas pa ci tsam shar yang re dogs med par lam du 'khyer thub dgos/ 'jigs med gling pa la grong pa'i mo btsun yan chod kyis 'phya ba sogs 'tshub slong mang po byung bar gsung yod/ re zhig rang ngo skyong mu nas grib sel dang tshe sgrub zhig dang / bag yangs byas nas lta ba gtso bor bsgom gsung /

grib phog gi dogs pa'i rnam rtog rang grol la btang / yang yang skyes na rdzas de lag tu len pa dang steng du khyer ba sogs byas thogs brdzis byed dgos/ ci yong ba shog shi yang 'dra rnam rtog 'khrul ba bya ba yin bsam nas lam du khyer/ rmi lam du khams nyams pa la de tsam re dogs mi bya bar btang snyoms la bzhag na dga'/ drung du 'ong mkhan de 'dod chags can yin na rang la 'dod chags skye ba sogs 'byung dar/ lar 'di 'dra'i rigs nyams bzang ngan thams cad la dga' sdug byed mi nyan gsung / chos mdzod re zhig gzhan la ma bshad gsung / rmi lam du lha'i zhal mthong ba sogs la'ang dga' mi nyan gsung / lta ba'i ngang skyong thub na de sdig bshags yin pas ched du yig brgya sogs la ma 'bad kyang btub gsung / nyams len la brtan pa zhig ma thob bar re zhig chos 'tshol rgyu bzhag na dga' gsung / nyams len thams cad gsang na dga' gsung / blo gtad chig dril byed lugs ni/ skyabs gnas mthar thug bla ma yin/ yi dam gang bsgom kyang bla ma yi dam gyi rnam par byon pa yin/ dgos pa'i dbang gis bla ma drag po'i rnam par byon pa yin bsam dgos/ rang ngo shes pa'i gsal snang dang ldan pa'i ngang nas bdag bskyed bton na bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi lam du 'gyur gsung / za ngu zer ba pha rol gyi rgyu rdzas za bzhin du ngu bar mdzod zer ba'i don red/ sa bdag klu gnyen rnams la dngos nas bsang gsur sogs mthun par bya dgos/ klu 'di 'dris ngan zhig yin pas khyung gi sgo nas cung zad re bsdigs kyang dgos/ 'dre ngan gyi cho 'phrul bzlog pa la lta ba'i ngang du 'jog pa rab/ snying rjes 'dul ba 'bring / lha'i nga rgyal gyis drag sngags 'don pa tha ma lta bu yin/ chos skyong gi sku bla ma/ gsung yi dam/ thugs mkha' 'gro/ yon tan nor lha/ phrin las srung mar shes pa'i ngang nas gsol mchod gyis/ snying ma'i gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor du 'jig rten dregs byed thams cad dkyil 'khor du bkod pa de thams cad ye shes gcig gi rol par shes pa'i gnad yin gsung /

dam sel can dang lhan du dbang zhu ba sogs byed dgos tshe mnyam nyid kyi ngang skyong ba gnad yin/ tshes bcu'i gtor ma la sku bzhag sman rag la bdud rtsi btab/ srung ma'i gsol mchod mdor bsdus byas na mthus/ rmi lam sprul bsgyur nyin mo sbyang ba gal che/ 'od gsal zin thabs dang po gnyid/ de nas 'od gsal zin pa'i gsol 'debs byas te seng ge'i nyal stabs byas la mig phyed btsum ran pas ma yengs par ngang skyong ba gnad yin gsung // ༈ //gzhi dus kyi dregs pa rgyud gsum la/ phyi'i rgyud gsum ni sangs rgyas nas grong khyer gyi 'gong po yan chod dregs pa pho rgyud/ yum gyi char snang ba nas grong khyer gyi bse mo yan chod dregs pa mo rgyud/ bla ma dang yi dam nas klu btsan yan chod dregs pa gnyis med rgyud/ nang gi rgyud gsum ni/ g.yas rtsa ro ma pho rgyud/ g.yon rkyang ma mo rgyud/ dbu ma gnyis med kyi rgyud do/ /gsang ba'i rgyud gsum gsal ba pho rgyud/ stong pa mo rgyud/ zung 'jug gnyis med rgyud/ thabs rgyud kyi dregs pa rgyud gsum ni/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs rdzogs pa gsal la ma 'gag par snang ba pho rgyud/ nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga'i rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa'i rdzogs rim gyi cha mo rgyud/ de la brten te skyes pa'i nyams myong gi ye shes gnyis med rgyud/ 'bras rgyud kyi dregs pa rgyud gsum ni sems nyid gsal ba glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba sprul sku ni pho rgyud/ stong pa mngon gyur chos sku mo rgyud/ zung 'jug ngo bo nyid sku gnyis med kyi rgyud/ yang lha sku snang ba'i cha pho rgyud/ rang bzhin gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong cha mo rgyud/ dbyer med gnyis med rgyud/ rjes thob spyod pa'i skabs/ mig gi yul du snang ba thams cad lha'i ngo bor shes pa la rgyud gsum gong ltar sbyar/ rna ba'i lam du sgra grags pa thams cad sngags su shes pa la'ang gong bzhin sbyar/
